jobs.company: Altia Central (株式会社 アルティアセントラル)
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Conversational Visa sponsorship available Description ALTIA CENTRAL is now accepting applications from all candidates overseas or in Japan to join our fantastic team of ALTs from August 2026 and beyond! Overseas Applicants - Please note that consideration for earlier openings will depend on COE and visa processing times. In-Country Applicants - We continue to accept applications on an ongoing basis for mid-year and future placements. If you would like to live and work in Japan, or make a return to Japan and work with one of the most reputable and successful companies in the ALT industry, then please apply now. ---About The Position--- ▲ Full Time ▲ Yearly salary + annual bonus: ¥3,000,000 (Monthly ¥240,000) ▲ Positions may include: junior high, elementary schools and kindergarten ▲ Most positions will require driving ▲ Health Insurance: Shakai Hoken (includes health and pension) or Kokumin Hoken, depending on placement Our contracts are largely based in central Japan, mostly in Aichi, Gifu, and Shizuoka prefectures; with a strong presence in Okayama and Hiroshima; a number of contracts in Shiga, Mie, Nagano, and Fukui; as well as a limited number of positions in Osaka, Kyoto and the greater Kansai area. If you are focused on going to Osaka and Osaka only, we will most likely not be able to help you out. Please note that we DO NOT have anything in the greater Tokyo Area. ---What We Offer--- We want to support your growth and development to become a great ALT. The skills and experiences you will gain with us, will greatly benefit you in various ways for your future career. But don’t take our word for it, see for yourself what others say on sites like Glassdoor and Reddit. ---Benefits--- ▲ Full salary every month, no prorated months, paid on-time every time ▲ Outstanding and reliable support from Supervisors and staff ▲ Comprehensive benefits package with paid Annual Leave days ▲ Housing support: we pay key money and deposit for company sponsored apartments so you don’t have to ▲ Reimbursements: public transportation, bicycle, and more ▲ Driving support: we pay for the car lease and offer a variety of driving plans to suit your needs (up to and including fully paid plans where we pay gas, insurance, maintenance, etc.), and more ▲ Industry-leading training: tailored to your needs, taught by highly skilled trainers, hands-on, ongoing year-round, and professional development for your future career ▲ Resources and materials: access to top-quality educational resources anytime through our members website including storyboards, flashcards, songs, example lesson plans and more ▲ Visa Sponsorship ---Key Qualifications--- ▲ Native English speaker ▲ Bachelor's degree (or higher) ▲ Engaging, enthusiastic, and dedicated to providing a positive communicative experience for students ▲ Flexible, sociable, culturally sensitive, and eager to live in Japan for a minimum of one year ▲ Previous teaching experience ranging from ALT to ESL tutoring within Japan or in other countries ▲ Must have at least a basic level of Japanese with a conversational level being strongly preferred ▲ Previous time spent studying or working in Japan is appreciated but not required ▲ As many ALT positions do require driving, applicants who can or would be able to drive in Japan on either a Japanese license or International Driving Permit are preferred ---The Role--- An ALT’s work in public schools centers around creating positive interactions with the students both inside and outside the classroom and helping to provide enjoyable and energetic lessons. ALTs also develop and maintain a positive and supportive professional relationship with Japanese teachers by assisting with various tasks during the school year. ALTs will experience prolonged periods of standing, walking, and stair climbing. ALTs will also be encouraged to perform high energy movements such as running and playing with students. To help you find success in this role, our ALTs are frequently evaluated throughout the year based on their lesson’s clarity, how supportive they are, and the overall atmosphere they help to create in the classroom. We are dedicated to helping our ALTs grow and improve for their future success by offering ongoing advice, feedback, and more. Working as an ALT is a great opportunity to improve your Japanese language ability, experience and appreciate cultural differences, and most importantly, to be positively involved with the development and well-being of Japanese students. ---The Application Process--- Once we receive your resume and cover letter, we will only reply to qualified applicants via email. Those that pass our subsequent screening questionnaire will then be invited to an interview. All of our interviews are conducted virtually using Google Meet. If you are interested in applying, please visit our Recruiting website for further details about ALTIA CENTRAL.

jobs.title: 【Remote】Global Marketing / Localization / Culturalization (English)
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description We handle the localization and culturalization of the illustration, manga, webtoon, and animation app Clip Studio Paint, along with its related services and tutorial content, while also promoting the app to audiences in North America and Europe. ▼ Department activities Clip Studio Paint is the graphics app used by over 60 million users around the world and is bundled with Wacom pen tablets and Samsung devices. The Global Marketing Team focuses on both the localization and culturalization of Clip Studio Paint and its related services as well as marketing Clip Studio Paint to North America and Europe. You will be tasked with planning and producing content that helps creators use our app, as well as planning and managing advertising and marketing campaigns to promote the app from Japan to the world. ▼ Related projects and who you will work with ・Work alongside in-house designers to execute promotion plans, create web pages, creatives, and other content ・Collaborate with our development team to create resource text for our apps and services using your localization/culturalization abilities ▼ Job Outline 【Marketing work】 Your assigned tasks will be based on your experience, skills, and preferences. We plan promotional campaigns, review them internally, and execute them with the team after approval. We review campaign results to inform future promotions. Current key initiatives include the following: - Influencer marketing campaigns with a focus on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube - Event workshops and live drawing sessions (To be run by local creators) - Social media management to boost awareness and create fans - Google/ Social media advertisement optimization - SEO strategy for owned media articles 【Localization/culturalization】 A coordinator will assign internal translation requests for the UI of the app and its services, user guides, websites, and marketing materials to the appropriate team member. Translation tasks are managed using Backlog and the translation tool memoQ. Another staff member then reviews the translated work and finalizes the task. ▼ Hardware and tools 【Hardware】 ・PC (Windows, Mac) ・Mobile OS (iPad, iPhone, Android, Chromebook) 【Tools】 General tools: Translation tool (memoQ), Google Workspace, Clip Studio Paint, DocuSign Communication tools: Backlog, Gyazo, Slack, Zoom Other: ChatGPT and other AI tools can be used ▼ Why work with us? ・Hold events, contests, and more outside of Japan planned and executed by you ・There is a possibility to work alongside pro comic artists, illustrators, animators, and more through sponsoring artists and events ・Reach fans all over the world through your translations in the app and its services, tutorial content, social media, and more ・Be a part of making something. Listen to user feedback and brainstorm ideas to improve the app and its services ▼ Environment and career path In addition to developing your skills as a marketer and translator, you may also have the opportunity to take on management roles such as language team leader, section head, or department head. ▼ Requirements ・Native speaker of the English language with a business level command of Japanese (JLPT N2 or above) ・Experience in at least one of the following marketing areas in North America or Europe, with 3+ years of experience: - Ad networks, SEO, social media management、website and content writing, website direction, video content planning, B2B sales and relations, promotion planning, public relations or related work ・Experience translating from Japanese to English ▼ Welcome skills ・Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Procreate, or other graphics apps/software ・Loves to draw ・Digital artists who draw illustrations or manga ▼ We want someone who... ・Is willing to take on new challenges ・Is good at analyzing results, devising strategies for improvement, and implementing them ・Actively shares their opinions and ideas while respecting others ・Is passionate about supporting creators in their assigned region and spreading Clip Studio Paint to as many people as possible ▼ Benefits 【Salary】 5 million to 7 million yen 【Monthly salary】 (1)Range: 344,000 yen to 485,000 yen (including the amount in (2)) (2)The monthly salary includes 45 hours of fixed overtime (92,880 yen to 130,950 yen) (3)Overtime hours exceeding fixed overtime will be paid out separately (4)The annual salary includes a remote work allowance or flexible work allowance (10,000 yen per month) ※Salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and other factors. 【Working conditions】 Working hours: 10:00 - 18:30 Holidays: 120 days or more of holidays, five-day work week (Sat. Sun. holidays), annual paid leave (including summer vacation), New Year holiday ・Personal holidays (wedding leave, wedding leave for wedding of a child, childbirth leave, bereavement leave) ※Summer vacation and personal holidays are only available for permanent employees ・Remote work is allowed 【Benefits】 ・Remote work allowance, transportation costs ・Child benefits ・Maternity leave, childcare leave ・Shorten hours for childcare ・Retirement benefits ・Language learning support ・Various other benefits for life events 【Other benefits】 ・Comprehensive social insurance coverage ・Health checkups, including breast and cervical cancer screenings for women ・Free health checkups for dependent spouses ・Employee stock ownership plan ・Casual dress code ・Company app provided to interested employees ・Ability to borrow devices required for work ▼ Selection Process Document Screening → Trial Translation → First Interview → Second Interview → Job Offer ・After passing the document screening, you will be asked to submit a trial translation and a hearing sheet for review. ・A third interview may be conducted if necessary. ・We will inform you of the result of each stage within approximately one week.

jobs.description: 【事業内容】 Bamosグループは、デジタルマーケティング支援・映像制作・旅行サービスという3事業を横断的に展開する成長企業です。 SNS広告を中心としたデジタルマーケティング支援、動画広告・ブランドムービーを手がける映像制作事業、「人で選ぶ旅」を再定義する旅行サービス事業を擁し、単一事業ではなくグループ全体で拡張するコングロマリットモデルを追求しています。 創業2期目に年商20億円を突破、現在4期目で38億円規模に到達。 次の目標は年商100億円。 その成長を支える経営管理基盤の構築が、現フェーズの最重要テーマです。 【仕事内容】 ■ ポジションの役割 経営管理部を専任で統括するバックオフィス責任者として、CHROが経営・人事戦略に専念できる体制づくりを担います。 既存の仕組みを引き継ぐのではなく、体制・ルール・文化をゼロから設計する、まさに「初代」としての役割です。 ■ 具体的な業務内容 ・経営管理部(現5名)のマネジメント(業務管理・進捗フォロー・育成、部門全体の生産性向上のサポート) ・経理・財務・人事・総務・法務・労務の実務管理・運営(各領域の実務品質の確保、リソース調整) ・組織拡大に向けた業務フロー・仕組みづくりへの参画(管理部門の体制整備・改善) ・月次・年次決算対応、予実管理のサポート(経営陣への報告資料の作成・とりまとめ) ・コーポレートガバナンス・内部統制強化への貢献(CHROと連携した体制整備の推進) ・CHRO・代表と連携した経営課題への対応(経営会議への参加、全社課題解決のサポート)

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Fluent Required Japanese Level: Basic Level Current Residence Requirement: Japan Visa Sponsorship: Future possibility / Renewal The Role As Assistant Manager, you’ll work directly with the Manager to support operations, staff, and guest experience. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a desk job. You’ll lead by example during service and help keep the team motivated, organized, and confident. Key Responsibilities Support daily bar & restaurant operations during service Supervise staff on shift (bartenders, floor staff, kitchen coordination) Help train new staff and support ongoing skill development Ensure friendly, fast, and consistent customer service Handle guest issues calmly and professionally Assist with cash handling, POS, and end-of-day procedures Support inventory checks, ordering, and stock organization Help manage shift schedules and last-minute adjustments Maintain cleanliness, safety, and venue standards Act as Manager-in-Charge when the Manager is off Ideal Candidate Experience in a bar, restaurant, or hospitality environment Comfortable working in a busy, social, late-night setting Good people skills: a firm but friendly leadership style Can communicate clearly with both Japanese and non-Japanese staff English conversational level preferred (Japanese strongly valued) Reliable, calm under pressure, and solution-oriented Enjoys customer interaction and building regulars Job Description Assistant Manager – International Bar & Restaurant (Nagoya) Location: Nagoya, Aichi Employment Type: Full-time Schedule: Evenings / weekends included Start Date: Flexible About the Venue We are a friendly, high-energy international bar & restaurant in Nagoya with a strong community vibe. Our venue is known for great drinks, casual food, events, and known for great authentic western food and amazing drinks. Many of our customers are regulars, and teamwork and personality matter as much as experience. We’re looking for an Assistant Manager who enjoys being on the floor with the the staff, guiding and supporting staff, and being the glue to help build and run the venue day to day. Salary & Benefits Monthly Salary: ¥280,000 – ¥330,000 (depending on experience and responsibility) Additional Benefits Include: Fixed overtime allowance Staff meals / drink discounts Paid leave & social insurance (per Japanese labor law) Why Join Us? Friendly, international work environment Strong team culture with long-term staff Real input into operations and improvements Clear path toward Manager / General Manager role A workplace where personality and leadership matter How to Apply Send your resume and a short message about your hospitality experience and availability.

jobs.title: English language marketer (Unit Leader)
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Basic Level Current Residence Requirement: Japan Visa Sponsorship: Yes 【 Must-Have Skills 】 At least 1 year of proven leadership experience (team lead, project lead, or equivalent, team management) At least 3 years of experience in digital marketing Strong proficiency in data analysis (data management, analysis, reporting and planning) Hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns (Specifically Google Ads and Meta Ads) Native-English language proficiency skills (CEFR C1/C2, TOEFL score 95–120) 【 Preferred Skills 】 Hands-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4) and Looker Studio ● Strong proficiency in Google Sheets Proficiency with setting up automations (Google App Script, Zapier, etc.) Able to read and navigate HTML code Able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment 【 Personality 】 Data-Focused Possesses strong professional experience managing digital paid advertising (PPC) campaigns and making data-driven decisions based on performance metrics. Has a proven track record of analyzing data to identify growth opportunities, solve problems, and improve overall advertising performance. Adaptable & Culturally Aware Comfortable working in a multicultural environment and able to adapt communication styles to collaborate effectively with digital marketers from around the world. Proactive Attitude Self-motivated with a strong desire for professional growth while supporting the development of team members. We are looking for leaders who enjoy taking on new challenges, motivating others, and maintaining a positive mindset when facing obstacles. The ideal candidate is proactive, takes ownership of their work, and can drive initiatives with minimal supervision. Team-Oriented Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with team members to achieve shared goals. Successful leaders at ZenGroup are open to both giving and receiving constructive feedback and actively contribute to the growth and development of their team. Positive Mindset We are looking for leaders who can maintain focus, stay positive, and keep their team motivated in a fast-paced environment, while remaining flexible and adapting quickly as priorities change. Job Description English language marketer (Unit Leader) The English-language version of ZenMarket has grown significantly since its launch, serving customers from around the world who want to purchase products directly from Japanese Ecommerce marketplaces. As the global cross-border Ecommerce industry continues to expand, we see significant opportunities to further grow our English-speaking market. To support this growth, we are looking for an experienced English Market Team Leader to manage ongoing marketing projects, track and report performance, prioritize initiatives, and efficiently allocate tasks within a growing team. This role requires a leader who can drive projects forward, make data-driven decisions, and empower team members to achieve shared goals. This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding one of ZenMarket's largest markets while helping shape the future growth of our global marketing organization. < Main Duties > PPC marketing (Google ads, Meta ads, etc.) Social media marketing (Instagram, Facebook, Tiktok, etc.) Influencer marketing (Sponsorship, Collaboration, Integration, etc.) Content Marketing (SEO, organic marketing, etc.) Email marketing (Mass and Niche Marketing) Data analysis (Generating reports and dashboards on Google Analytics, Google Sheets, Looker Studio, etc.) Supervise English localization tasks Project management skills, including KPI planning, performance tracking, campaign planning, and campaign execution <About Us > ZenGroup is an Ecommerce company based in Osaka, Japan, with over 400 active employees across our headquarters and logistics centers. With a diverse workforce representing more than 34 nationalities, we support the international market in purchasing products from Japan and help Japanese companies sell their products overseas. ZenGroup currently operates the following five services: ZenMarket : A proxy-buying platform that enables international customers to shop in their own language on major Japanese Ecommerce sites such as Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, Yahoo Shopping, and more. ZenPlus : An Ecommerce marketplace that connects over 3,000 small to mid-sized Japanese businesses with international customers. ● ZenPromo : A promotional service that helps Japanese companies refine their international marketing strategies and build global brand awareness. ZenLink : An HTML tag-based service for Japanese Ecommerce companies that enables their products to be purchased on ZenMarket, driving international web traffic to their stores. ZenStudio : A creative agency specializing in web design and video production, supporting businesses entering digital media or enhancing their Ecommerce presence to meet modern trends. Today, our platform has over 2 million registered users, is available in 19 languages, and serves customers in over 181 countries across six continents—delivering Japanese products to the world. Job Description ALTIA CENTRAL is now accepting applications from all candidates overseas or in Japan to join our fantastic team of ALTs from August 2026 and beyond! If you would like to live and work in Japan, or make a return to Japan and work with one of the most reputable and successful companies in the ALT industry, then please apply now. Overseas Applicants - Please note that consideration for earlier openings will depend on COE and visa processing times. In-Country Applicants - We continue to accept applications on an ongoing basis for mid-year and future placements. ---About The Position--- ▲ Full Time ▲ Yearly salary + annual bonus: ¥3,000,000 (Monthly ¥240,000) ▲ Positions may include: junior high, elementary schools and kindergarten ▲ Most positions will require driving ▲ Health Insurance: Shakai Hoken (includes health and pension) or Kokumin Hoken, depending on placement Our contracts are largely based in central Japan, mostly in Aichi, Gifu, and Shizuoka prefectures; with a strong presence in Okayama and Hiroshima; a number of contracts in Shiga, Mie, Nagano, and Fukui; as well as a limited number of positions in Osaka, Kyoto and the greater Kansai area. If you are focused on going to Osaka and Osaka only, we will most likely not be able to help you out. Please note that we DO NOT have anything in the greater Tokyo Area. ---What We Offer--- We want to support your growth and development to become a great ALT. The skills and experiences you will gain with us, will greatly benefit you in various ways for your future career. But don’t take our word for it, see for yourself what others say on sites like Glassdoor and Reddit. ---Benefits--- ▲ Full salary every month, no prorated months, paid on-time every time ▲ Outstanding and reliable support from Supervisors and staff ▲ Comprehensive benefits package with paid Annual Leave days ▲ Housing support: we pay key money and deposit for company sponsored apartments so you don’t have to ▲ Reimbursements: public transportation, bicycle, and more ▲ Driving support: we pay for the car lease and offer a variety of driving plans to suit your needs (up to and including fully paid plans where we pay gas, insurance, maintenance, etc.), and more ▲ Industry-leading training: tailored to your needs, taught by highly skilled trainers, hands-on, ongoing year-round, and professional development for your future career ▲ Resources and materials: access to top-quality educational resources anytime through our members website including storyboards, flashcards, songs, example lesson plans and more ▲ Visa Sponsorship ---The Role--- An ALT’s work in public schools centers around creating positive interactions with the students both inside and outside the classroom and helping to provide enjoyable and energetic lessons. ALTs also develop and maintain a positive and supportive professional relationship with Japanese teachers by assisting with various tasks during the school year. ALTs will experience prolonged periods of standing, walking, and stair climbing. ALTs will also be encouraged to perform high energy movements such as running and playing with students. To help you find success in this role, our ALTs are frequently evaluated throughout the year based on their lesson’s clarity, how supportive they are, and the overall atmosphere they help to create in the classroom. We are dedicated to helping our ALTs grow and improve for their future success by offering ongoing advice, feedback, and more. Working as an ALT is a great opportunity to improve your Japanese language ability, experience and appreciate cultural differences, and most importantly, to be positively involved with the development and well-being of Japanese students. ---The Application Process--- Once we receive your resume and cover letter, we will only reply to qualified applicants via email. Those that pass our subsequent screening questionnaire will then be invited to an interview. All of our interviews are conducted virtually using Google Meet. If you are interested in applying, please visit our Recruiting website for further details about ALTIA CENTRAL.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: At ZEALS, we’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of conversational AI products. Our conversational commerce platform processes millions of customer conversations every day on a high-volume, event-driven system built from dozens of microservices. In parallel, we’re rapidly expanding Omakase.ai, our new AI agent platform, and developing deeper integrations between our products to unlock new capabilities and use cases. Joining the SRE team means more than maintaining production systems—you’ll help shape the infrastructure that powers multiple AI products. From improving reliability and performance to enabling new feature development and platform integrations, you’ll have the opportunity to work on challenging, large-scale engineering problems while influencing the future architecture of our services. Responsibilities Keep critical customer journeys reliable and available, and respond first when they aren’t. Join the on-call rotation for business critical services. Own alerting and observability: better coverage, fewer false positives, and catching issues before customers do. Build and operate in-house platform tooling: Kubernetes operators, custom Kubernetes APIs, GitOps automation, and deployment tooling that helps teams ship faster and safer. Eliminate toil by turning recurring developer requests into self-service, bringing an automation mindset to reduce complexity. Drive down platform cost without trading away reliability. Design infrastructure that scales with bursty, high-volume traffic, managed as code across many environments. Measure the platform against Well-Architected principles and act on what’s weak, whether that’s a reliability gap, an oversized resource, or a manual process worth automating. Requirements 3+ years in software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or platform engineering on GCP or AWS. Hands-on Kubernetes experience: you can debug a workload, not just deploy one. Monitoring and observability experience (we use Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, and Thanos). Comfortable troubleshooting databases (we run MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and Postgres). CI/CD and GitOps experience (we use GitHub Actions, Helm, and Argo CD). Able to write and read code for tooling and automation (we use Go, Bash, and Python). Eligible to work in Japan, and business-level English. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Terraform and infrastructure-as-code at scale. Go proficiency and experience building Kubernetes operators. Operating event-driven systems and high-throughput messaging at scale. Conversational Japanese.

jobs.title: 🌍 Global Inbound Sales Consultant – No Real Estate Experience Required! Tailored Fast-Track Training / Partner with Global UHNW
jobs.description: In this role, you will provide premium inbound sales and asset consulting services to international Ultra-High-Net-Worth (UHNW) individuals, corporate clients, and family offices looking to invest in luxury Japanese properties. (100% inbound marketing; strictly NO cold calling or door-to-door selling). [Job Highlights] World-Class Brand: Exclusive Japan partner for "Forbes GLOBAL PROPERTIES," the ultimate network for elite luxury real estate. Uncapped High Commission: 5% to 20% payout rate. (Actual 1st-year employee earned 12.5M JPY. Active members earning 50M+ JPY, with uncapped potential to go even higher as our deal volume scales). The "6-Agent Team" Support: We assign a dedicated 6-member team for every project. Administrative tasks are 100% handled by specialized departments, ensuring you never feel isolated and can focus purely on providing high-level consultations. Maximize Your English Skills: Engage daily with international UHNW investors and global partners. Opportunities to accompany the CEO on global business trips and attend international conferences. [Key Workflow] Inbound Response & Outreach: Manage and optimize property listings on top-tier luxury portals like Forbes GLOBAL PROPERTIES, JamesEdition, and LuxuryEstate, and respond to international incoming inquiries. End-to-End Consulting: Conduct video consultations to understand global clients' investment/lifestyle goals, host high-end property viewings in Japan, and coordinate cross-border transactions with legal experts. Global Collaboration: Actively communicate with international partners and contribute to strategic planning for developing new global accounts. ◆ Strategically Tailored Training Plan for the Fastest Route to Success While this role involves highly dynamic international interactions, a solid understanding of Japanese real estate operations and market data is non-negotiable when consulting with global UHNW clients. Rather than providing a standard, rigid training schedule, we analyze each candidate's background, existing skills, and current organizational needs to design a personalized, strategic roadmap that ensures the fastest path to becoming an independent global sales professional. Training Path Examples: If we determine that building a foundation from scratch is your fastest route to success, you will spend your first year handling domestic property transactions to master real estate brokerage (our domestic sales team is highly diverse, where members thrive regardless of gender). On the other hand, if your current skills and business urgency align, you may be deployed directly into international accounts from an early stage, progressively expanding your responsibilities. We evaluate your individual readiness and organizational dynamics to place you on the most optimal path to maximize your global potential.

jobs.title: International Preschool Assistant Teacher
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description SOLTILO GSA International School is looking for motivated homeroom teachers and senior teachers for the opening of a new campus in Ebina, Kanagawa. SOLTILO GSA International School (SGIS)’s brand new campus will open in the "Family Building" within ViNA GARDENS, which is scheduled to open in the spring of 2027. The school will blend the acclaimed sports program of Keisuke Honda's SOLTILO with the international school curriculum of Global Step Academy. The new campus will welcome up to 100 students and 20 staff members. [Important] This job posting is NOT for an “Eikaiwa” teacher, “ALT,” or English teacher position. Candidates are expected to support children’s social and physical development while assisting in teaching multiple subjects in English, such as literacy, math, and social studies. [Main Duties] ● Demonstrate various educational and recreational activities for students to participate in. ● Assist in planning and teaching language arts, math, science, social studies, and, when necessary, other subjects in accordance with the school’s monthly curriculum. ● Encourage children to actively interact with their classmates and support the development of their social skills. ● Provide support and communicate with parents. ● Observe and evaluate students’ growth and development. ● Prepare lessons and complete the reports and documents required by law. ● Serve as a bus attendant for the children. ● Providing childcare, including diaper changing when necessary. [Requirements] ●Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. ●Strong English communication skills. ●Excellent interpersonal skills. ●Experience working with children. ●Ability to build relationships with students and staff from different cultures and nationalities. ●Ability to work independently, multitask, and effectively prioritize assignments. [Salary] 280,000 yen – 300,000 yen per month (depending on experience, responsibilities, and qualifications). [Working Conditions] Working hours: 8 hours per day (40 hours per week) + 1-hour break. Overtime: up to 8 hours per month included. Working days: Monday to Friday. Holidays: Japanese National Holidays + School Holidays + 10 days of personal paid leave. Benefits: transportation allowance (up to 20,000 yen/month), Social Insurance (Shakai Hoken) for full-time employees, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.title: MC for Sumo Show in Kyoto
jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: Business level Description SUMO SHOW MC | Kyoto Sumo Club | Full-Time Share Japanese Culture with the World Salary: ¥280,000–¥400,000/month (Based on Experience & Performance) Location: Kyoto, Japan Be the Face of One of Japan's Most Unique Cultural Experiences This isn't just an MC position. It's an opportunity to entertain thousands of international visitors each year while introducing them to one of Japan's most iconic traditions. As the SUMO SHOW MC at Kyoto Sumo Club, you'll lead live performances, engage audiences from around the world, and help create unforgettable memories for guests visiting Japan. If you're confident speaking in front of crowds, love performing, and enjoy working in an international environment, this is a career unlike any other. About Mediabound Mediabound is one of Japan's fastest-growing inbound tourism companies. Our mission is simple: To preserve Japanese culture and transform it into world-class entertainment. We create immersive cultural experiences for international visitors through businesses including: Kyoto Sumo Club Shinjuku Sumo Club Matcha Making Experiences Coin Ring Making Studio Kintsugi Workshops Zen Arts & Crafts Studios Traveling Kyoto Traveling Tokyo Every month, thousands of guests from around the world experience Japanese culture through Mediabound. As we continue to grow, we're looking for passionate people who want to build their careers while sharing Japan with the world. What You'll Do As the MC, you'll be the host and storyteller of our live sumo experience. Responsibilities include: Host multiple live sumo shows each day Welcome guests and introduce the experience Explain the history, traditions, and rules of sumo in an engaging and entertaining way Keep audiences energized throughout the performance Facilitate interactive guest participation segments Work closely with wrestlers and operations staff to ensure smooth performances Answer guest questions in English and Japanese Assist with venue operations before and after each show Help maintain exceptional guest satisfaction Continuously improve the presentation and guest experience What Makes This Job Unique Perform Every Day Use your communication skills to entertain audiences from around the world. Use English Daily Speak with international guests and develop your presentation skills in a bilingual environment. No Two Days Are the Same Every audience is different, making every performance exciting and rewarding. Build a Career Join a rapidly growing startup where strong performers have opportunities to grow into leadership roles. Make a Real Impact You'll play a direct role in shaping one of the highlights of our guests' trip to Japan. We're Looking For Someone Who Is Outgoing and energetic Comfortable speaking in front of large groups Passionate about Japanese culture Confident in both English and Japanese Professional and dependable A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment Experience in public speaking, hospitality, tourism, entertainment, theater, education, or customer service is highly valued. Language Requirements Business-Level English Business-Level Japanese Compensation ¥280,000–¥400,000 per month Salary based on experience and performance Benefits Full-time employment Social insurance Employment insurance Workers' compensation insurance Transportation expenses fully covered Paid annual leave Public holidays according to company schedule Annual performance bonus Career development opportunities Our Values Speed is King We move quickly and execute with urgency. Customer Obsession Every decision begins with creating unforgettable guest experiences. Professionalism and Class We represent Japanese hospitality with pride. Relentless Perseverance We embrace challenges and continuously improve. If you love performing, meeting people from around the world, and sharing Japanese culture through unforgettable experiences, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become the face of Kyoto Sumo Club.

jobs.title: Multiple Positions for Experienced Preschool Teacher and Tech/Fine Arts Coach
jobs.description: Requirements English: Fluent Japanese: Business level Visa sponsorship available Description We are seeking to fill TWO different positions. The first position is for a full-time preschool teacher for ages 3-6. The second position is for a Computer Arts Coach. Successful applicants will start in March 2027 or ASAP depending on visa situation. More information can be found below. Location: M’s English, Takasaki City and Maebashi City, Gunma General Company Job Description and Duties: - must hold a valid International Driving Permit or Japanese Driver’s License - must have a Bachelor’s degree or higher in any field - demonstrate fluent English ability - claim citizenship from a country where the official language is English - participate in all school events. a. Events can include elementary students’ performances, seasonal events, textbook fairs, etc. b. Events/performances typically occur on a Sunday. There are at least 6 events in an academic year. Staff attendance is mandatory for assigned events, and a special Event Fee will be paid for this time. - General Staff Meetings are held twice a year (Spring / Fall) and typically occur on a Monday. Staff attendance is mandatory for these meetings. Staff will be paid either a flat fee for the day or an hourly rate, depending on the situation. - Participate in planning and making materials - 40-hour / 5-day working week with consecutive days off Company Philosophy: 1. Offer the best and allow no compromises by valuing each one of our customers and eagerly thinking of ways to solve problems. 2. Allow each staff member to grow as a person and expand their potential through work, as well as both financially and spiritually. 3. Contribute to society through business development and always think of society’s needs. Preschool Teacher Job Description and Duties: - Plan age-appropriate (3-6 years old) educational activities - manage classroom behavior - monitor developmental milestones - partner with Japanese co-teacher to create a safe, play-based and nurturing environment - have minimum 3 years of preschool teaching experience - IB education experience highly preferred - Main/Lead teacher experience highly preferred Computer Arts Coach Job Description and Duties - Be a mentor to the students - Assist students in the Self-Learning Phase and Onboarding Phase at TUMO: - Track the students overall performance using the TUMO360 system - Guide and support students throughout their TUMO journey - Scheduling, help with activities, motivation, personal life - Help students grow their skills both hard skills and soft skills - Coaches must have basic knowledge in all the skill areas - Being knowledgeable about popular media is a bonus: find common interests in games, anime, drawing, shows, movies and art - Be an intermediary between workshop leaders and the students - Explain activity requirements - Office Work Requirements: - Proficiency in Japanese (N2 Level or above) - Able to communicate with students, staff, parents and officials both verbally and through email/text - Read/write reports and spreadsheets in Japanese - Explain and give presentations in Japanese - Computer Skill Knowledge - Ability to solve problems and critical thinking related to software and design - Ability to complete all the TUMO Activities over time (for every skill, levels both 1 and 2) Other - No accessories or piercings (more than one) - Natural hair color (up to one tone up is allowed such as a dark brown) - Presentable hair style and clothing (currently uniform shirt and vest is required, especially when government officials and visitors come) About us: M’s English is an expanding private English conversation school with 25 years of experience in the Maebashi-Takasaki area of Gunma Prefecture, offering a dynamic work environment to its teachers. M’s allows for both professional and personal growth and development. While working hard is a given, the passion of our team, the willingness to help each other, the friendliness, and the sense of purpose are what make the environment great. We believe people make all the difference to the happiness of others, so we are looking for the perfect individuals for our team. We have well-established nursery school, business, and university programs. We specialize in English conversation for students of all ages and levels. Teachers have the opportunity to teach students of all ages, and work on career-building projects such as curriculum creation, textbook content creation, editing, graphic design, recording and filming educational content, and much more. We publish our own textbooks and materials for use both in-house and all over Japan. A strong work ethic, solid communication skills, willingness to learn new things, the ability to manage your own time and projects, and flexibility are all musts. While not essential, previous pre-school or kindergarten teaching experience is highly preferred. In addition to orientation training, we provide ongoing hands-on training that will assist you in your development as an educator. We also offer training and teaching seminar opportunities throughout the year. Promotions (with corresponding pay incentives) are possible for diligent teachers who take on leadership roles and show developmental growth. We offer visa sponsorship and renewal. Please see below for application requirements and position benefits. Contract, Remuneration, Benefits & Holidays: The successful candidate will be offered contract from their chosen start date with the option to renew for the next academic year and a salary based on teaching experience and overall performance. In addition to the benefits listed below, staff may receive annual raises and bonuses according to their contribution to the company and the company’s financial performance. Holidays: The Company shall provide 10 days of paid holiday time during the winter, 10 days during the summer, and one week each during spring and autumn, which comes out to more than one month’s salary of holiday time paid to the Employee during the year. We also offer up to five days of paid sick leave a year. Misc. Benefits: There are additional salary benefits to teachers in the following situations. All amounts are paid as a one-time bonus upon completion of each year at M’s. • Master’s degree in TESOL/TEFL holders: 30,000 yen • CELTA holders: 20,000 yen • TEFL Certificate holders (obtained on-site, inclusive of practicum): 20,000 yen • TEFL Certificate holders (obtained online, minimum 120 hours): 10,000 yen • JLPT N2: 20,000 yen • JLPT N1: 30,000 yen M’s English also offers up to 30,000 yen as a bonus upon the successful completion of a teaching certificate program. Employee Discounts: We offer all employees a 20% discount on our in-house 40-minute foreign language lessons (Japanese, Korean, Chinese, etc.) Application Requirements: 1) Cover Letter 2) Resume 3) One current photo 4) Copy of university diploma 5) Current visa holders and residents of Japan Please note that incomplete applications will not be reviewed. We’re looking forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan 1Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience 2Essay coaching or writing support 3Passion for mentoring and supporting students 4Strong written and verbal communication skills 5Ability to conduct professional online meetings Description JOB DESCRIPTION ROUTE H UNIVERSITY ADMISSIONS COUNSELOR ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ COMPANY Benesse Corporation DEPARTMENT Online Learning Division Global Education Development Department EMPLOYMENT TYPE Independent Contractor LOCATION Fully Remote Occasional in-person participation may be requested for Route H events. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ABOUT ROUTE H Route H is a highly selective overseas university admissions counseling program based in Japan. We support ambitious students pursuing admission to some of the world's most competitive universities, including leading institutions in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and other global destinations. At Route H, we believe that exceptional applications are built not only on academic achievement but also on intellectual curiosity, self-awareness, purpose, and authentic storytelling. Our counseling model combines strategic admissions guidance provided by Japanese counselors with individualized narrative development and essay mentorship delivered by experienced native English-speaking counselors. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ POSITION OVERVIEW Route H is seeking exceptional native English-speaking counselors to mentor high-achieving high school students throughout the self-reflection and essay components of the overseas university application process. However, this role goes far beyond proofreading or editing. Successful counselors help students identify meaningful experiences, clarify their values and aspirations, develop compelling personal narratives, and communicate their stories with authenticity and confidence. Counselors work closely with Route H's Japanese counselor team that oversees admissions strategy, university selection, scheduling, scholarship applications, parent communication, and overall student management. This is a mentorship-focused role centered on student growth, reflection, and communication. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1Narrative Development & Essay Mentorship • Guide students through deep self-reflection, brainstorming, and story discovery • Help students identify experiences,and values that can form the foundation of compelling applications • Provide developmental feedback on: Common App Personal Essays Supplemental Essays UCAS Personal Statements Other University Essays • Support students in strengthening: Authenticity Clarity Structure Reflection Intellectual Engagement Personal Voice • Conduct one-on-one online meeting sessions (Between 1-4 a month) • Encourage students to take ownership of their applications while maintaining academic integrity 2Interview Preparation • Conduct mock interviews for university admissions • Help students communicate their ideas clearly and confidently • Provide feedback on verbal communication, self-presentation, and critical thinking 3Workshops (Route H Camp) & Team Collaboration • Facilitate or participate in Route H workshops and admissions-related sessions • Collaborate closely with Japanese admissions counselors regarding student progress and narrative direction • Contribute insights to strengthen Route H's counseling program ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ SCOPE OF ROLE Included Responsibilities • Essay mentoring and coaching • Narrative development • Brainstorming and self-reflection facilitation • Developmental editing and feedback • Interview preparation • Student mentorship • University selection and admissions strategy • Recommendation letter strategy Not Included The following responsibilities are managed primarily by Route H's Japanese counseling team: • Parent communication • Application timeline management • Japanese Scholarship strategy and planning • Japanese-language writing support • Administrative coordination ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for professionals who: • Are passionate about student growth and mentorship • Possess exceptional listening and communication skills • Can help students uncover authentic stories rather than manufacture them • Understand the role of narrative writing in highly selective admissions • Value integrity, empathy, and student ownership • Are collaborative and team-oriented • Enjoy working with highly motivated students from diverse backgrounds • Can challenge students intellectually while supporting them personally ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Native-level English proficiency Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience Essay coaching or writing support Strong written and verbal communication skills Excellent interpersonal and active listening skills Passion for mentoring and supporting students Ability to conduct professional online meetings ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: Teaching, tutoring, or mentoring students University admissions counseling or academic advising Journalism, communications, writing, editing, education, counseling, or related fields ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ OUR COUNSELING PHILOSOPHY At Route H, we believe: • Authenticity is more powerful than perfection. • The student's voice must remain at the center of the application. • Great essays emerge through reflection, conversation, and personal growth. • Counselors guide the process; they never write application essays for students. • Trust, empathy, and intellectual curiosity are essential to meaningful mentorship. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ WORKING ARRANGEMENT • Independent Contractor • Fully remote work environment, except for in-person Route H workshops • Flexible scheduling based on student assignments • Seasonal workload fluctuations during application cycles • Participation in biweekly counselor meetings are required • Visa sponsorship documentation will be provided by the company. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ COMPENSATION Compensation is determined based on the specific assignment and role. [Route H Counseling Assignment] Compensation is provided on a per-student basis and varies depending on the assignment. The standard counseling assignment includes: • JPY 20,000 per student per month • Average 2 one-on-one online meeting sessions per month (45 minutes each) • Average two rounds of feedback for each essay • Assignment period of up to nine months Examples based on student allocation: • If you are assigned 5 students: Monthly: JPY 100,000 / month Full Term (Up to 9 months): Up to JPY 900,000 in total • If you are assigned 10 students: Monthly: JPY 200,000 / month Full Term (Up to 9 months): Up to JPY 1,800,000 in total Additional compensation may be available for higher-level assignments and additional responsibilities. Student assignments are based on counselor availability, experience, and performance. Additional Assignment Compensation Possibilities: [Route G Group Lesson Assignment (Additional)] In addition to the Route H Counselling compensation, if you are also assigned to conduct group test preparation courses (TOEFL / SAT) for our group program, Route G, additional compensation will be provided on a per-class basis: We provide the following services mainly online, including domestic and overseas universities, to help students realize their desired career paths. ・English instruction (Academic English, TOEFL, SAT) ・Experience in teaching English or SAT to middle and high school students and advising on learning English ・TESOL, CELTA, or other teaching certificate Mon-Fri: 18:00-22:15, Sat-Sun: 10:00-18:00 -Work from home (remote work) Hourly wage: 4,000 yen Student management work, hourly wage: 1,500 yen / 6 students Monthly total: (Hourly wage: 4,000 yen, 4 hours a day, 3 days a week) Following 1+2= 207,000 yen 1 Instructor salary: 48,000 yen x 4 weeks = 192,000 yen 2 Incidental work salary: number of students (in the case of 20 students) x 30 minutes = 15,000 yen

jobs.description: Requirements English: Fluent Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan 日本語能力試験 N2以上 Description [Position Overview] MLJ Incorporated is a Tokyo-based international trading company representing over 30 automotive, outdoor, and pet-product brands, with a fast-growing e-commerce business. We are hiring a motivated Sales & Marketing Associate to help us expand. This is a rare chance to build a career in international sales and trading from the ground up — working directly with overseas customers, suppliers, and partners, and getting hands-on exposure to global markets and major industry events such as Tokyo Auto Salon. No prior experience in international trading is required. You’ll receive structured, hands-on training and ongoing support from experienced colleagues. [Compensation] • Estimated starting ¥4,100,000 and above per year, depending on experience • Monthly base: ¥250,000 and above, depending on experience • Twice-yearly bonus (summer and winter), based on individual evaluation and company performance 4.0 months' salary (FY2025 actual) • Total earnings grow with experience and contribution

jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description <仕事内容> 大手半導体メーカーを始めとする取引先企業の工場内で当社製の半導体製造装置の検査・点検、保守サービスとメンテナンスを担当。 まずは1ヶ月の基礎技術研修終了後、ある程度の技量が身につくまで、先輩からのOJTにて業務を覚えていただきます。その後、手順書に従って装置の定期点検や部品の洗浄、消耗パーツの交換等、決められた業務を複数人とチームを組んで作業します。 技術的な素養がなくても、問題なく仕事を覚えることができる環境です。 また、業務内容が大きく変わることがないため、安心して作業に取り組むことができます。業務を覚えて自信がついたら、自分の頑張り次第で次のステップに上がることも可能です。チームリーダーや高度な不具合対応等、あなたの力を必要としている業務はたくさんあります。 ≪ワークライフバランス≫ 勤務時間は配属先のチームにより異なりますが、日の実働が 7.5~11時間 のシフト制となります。夜勤を含む 3勤3休シフト や 4勤2休 などがあり、勤務日数はシフトによって異なります。日勤帯のシフトと比較すると、給与や休日が増えるため、自分に合ったライフスタイルを大切にできます。 転勤はありませんので、腰を据えたお仕事と生活ができます。 <1日の流れ(例)> 8:00 朝会 8:30 工場内移動 9:00 作業開始 11:30 昼食 12:30 作業再開 16:00 帰宅 <入社後の流れ> ▼3日間 オリエンテーション ▼1ヶ月間 基礎技術研修 ▼その後は先輩の指導の下、現場で少しずつ経験を積んでいきます。 ★社内公募制度を使って、カスタマーエンジニア等に進むことも可能です。 また、透明性と公平性の高い評価制度により、収入アップやキャリアアップを実現できます。 ≪身につくスキル≫ 保守マニュアルによるメンテナンス作業からのスタートとなります。不具合対応のサポト業務等技術レベルを上げる業務に挑戦することでカスタマーエンジニアを目指すという道も。 キャリアアップをすれば、給与は確実に上がっていきます。半導体に関する知識がない方でも研修やサポートが充実しているので安心してご応募ください! <以下のいずれかの方は歓迎いたします> ・エンジニア未経験でも、ものづくりにご興味がある方 ・土日休みや有休消化率が高い企業で、ワークライフバランスを求めている方 ・半導体・ディスプレイ業界にご興味がある方 ・機械系の保守や整備、保全、修理、サービスエンジニア、アフターサービスのお仕事にご興味がある方 ・設備メンテナンスや設備管理、設備工事、工場でのお仕事にご興味がある方 ・理系学部卒業者(機械、工業、電気、電子、化学、物理などの学科) <勤務時間> 9時〜21時の間でシフト制勤務(実働時間7.5時間・休憩1時間) <平均残業時間> 月平均10時間 <給与> 月給:29万0000円~万39万0000円 ※経験・能力を考慮し決定 <福利厚生> 社保完備 インセンティブ制度 自己啓発援助金(英会話スクール、技術セミナーなど) 社宅制度(転勤時) 社員持株会 ストックアワード(自社株の付与制度) 退職金制度 他 <応募資格> ・JLPT N2以上の会話力をお持ちの方 Job Description You will be responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and servicing our semiconductor manufacturing equipment at the production facilities of major semiconductor manufacturers and other client companies. After completing a one-month basic technical training program, you will receive on-the-job training (OJT) from experienced team members until you become familiar with the work. Once you are ready, you will perform routine maintenance according to established procedures, including periodic equipment inspections, parts cleaning, and replacement of consumable components. Most tasks are carried out as part of a team. No prior technical experience is required. Our comprehensive training program and support system allow you to develop the necessary skills with confidence. Since the job responsibilities remain relatively consistent, you can build your expertise steadily over time. As your skills improve, you will have opportunities to advance into positions such as Team Leader or Customer Engineer, where you will handle more advanced troubleshooting and technical support. Shift schedules typically range from 7.5 to 11 hours per day, including schedules such as: 3 days on / 3 days off (including night shifts) 4 days on / 2 days off Depending on your shift schedule, you may receive higher pay and enjoy more days off compared to standard daytime schedules, allowing you to choose a work style that best fits your lifestyle. No relocation is required, so you can build a stable career and personal life in one location. Example Daily Schedule 8:00 AM – Morning meeting 8:30 AM – Move to the work area inside the factory 9:00 AM – Begin maintenance work 11:30 AM – Lunch break 12:30 PM – Resume work 4:00 PM – Finish work and go home Training Program First 3 Days Company orientation First Month Basic technical training After Training Receive hands-on OJT with experienced technicians. Gradually take on more responsibilities as your skills develop. Employees can also apply through our internal job posting system to advance to positions such as Customer Engineer. Our transparent and fair performance evaluation system provides excellent opportunities for both career growth and salary increases. Career Development You will begin by performing maintenance work according to standard maintenance manuals. As your experience grows, you can take on technical support and equipment troubleshooting responsibilities, ultimately progressing toward a Customer Engineer position. The more your skills develop, the greater your earning potential. Even if you have no prior knowledge of the semiconductor industry, our comprehensive training and support will help you succeed. Preferred Qualifications We welcome applicants who are: Interested in manufacturing, even without engineering experience Looking for a company that values work-life balance and offers generous paid leave Interested in the semiconductor or display manufacturing industry Interested in careers involving machine maintenance, equipment repair, facility maintenance, service engineering, or after-sales service Interested in factory maintenance, facility management, or industrial equipment Graduates of science or engineering disciplines (Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Industrial Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, etc.) Working Hours Shift work between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM Actual working hours: 7.5 hours per day Break: 1 hour Average Overtime Approximately 10 hours per month Salary Monthly Salary: JPY 290,000 – JPY 390,000 Salary will be determined based on experience and skills. jobs.title: SAR Image Processing Engineer
jobs.description: The Data Production Department covers the lifecycle of the SAR data from downlink to delivery. Within this department, the SAR Processing unit is responsible for the development of the SAR image processing pipeline, which orchestrates deserialization, processing parameter estimation, focusing, and packaging into the different supported SAR data formats. Including its architecture, integration to ground systems and automation. This role is about turning algorithms into a reliable, scalable production pipeline. This is a hands-on, production-focused engineering role rather than a research position. You’ll need a genuine SAR foundation, but your impact will come from system and pipeline engineering: integrating the processing algorithms, hardening them, and scaling across all acquisition modes and product types. If you have a SAR/research background and want to move toward production and systems work, you’ll fit well with us. If you’ve moved into research, management, or adjacent roles and want to return to hands-on SAR engineering, you’re welcome too. If your goal is to stay in pure algorithm research, this role is not a good fit for you. While knowledge of SAR principles is essential, the primary output is production-grade software and system architecture. As a radar engineer in our unit, you will work with radar data processing and image analysis for large datasets, while contributing to the design and development of future satellites’ radar systems. Responsibilities Own and evolve the architecture of the SAR image processing pipeline Integrate and productionize SAR processing algorithms across acquisition modes and product types Investigate SAR image and processing issues, relating signal-level behavior (Doppler, geometry, focusing) to satellite and acquisition behavior Contribute to the end-to-end development of new SAR data products to expand our commercial offerings. Develop and automate tooling to analyze, troubleshoot, and verify products Collaborate with the design of a continuously growing ground system to include new operational modes Provide feedback on the system engineering of future satellites’ radar systems Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Remote Sensing, Physics, or a related field You’ve owned a piece of a production system or processing pipeline end-to-end. Typically 3+ years in signal/image processing, radar, or a related software-heavy domain Solid grasp of SAR fundamentals: image formation, acquisition modes, and the SAR processing chain, or closely transferable coherent / aperture-synthesis imaging experience (radar, array processing, ultrasound, seismic) Solid foundation in digital signal or image processing Ability to write maintainable code in teams (not just scripting) in at least one language used for scientific/production work (e.g., Python, C++, Rust) Can work in office in Tokyo Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience with spaceborne or airborne SAR data specifically Experience in Python and Rust Familiarity with SAR calibration, geometric/radiometric accuracy, or image-quality assessment Experience in satellite or remote sensing industry Good verbal and written Japanese

Responsibilities Product Strategy & Growth New Feature Innovation: Lead the end-to-end planning, scoping, and successful market launch of high-impact features aimed at monetization and value creation. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Machine Learning
jobs.description: We are seeking strong ML engineers to join the ML team and help us sharpen the ML vision and deliver more solutions to satisfy our customers’ needs. You will be working closely with other ML engineers and people from cross-functional teams. You will be a good fit if you: Are a self-driven, organized, and independent individual who proactively takes initiatives, anticipates needs, and solves problems to contribute to delivering values to our customers. Have a strong sense of ownership and responsibility to get things done. Have a growth mindset; are curious to learn new things and adaptive to changes. Know how to navigate ambiguity and thrive in uncertain environments, consistently driving work forward. Are passionate about productizing ML products, knowing how to make practical trade-offs when turning ideas into working software. Excel in adapting communication styles and simplifying complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, ensuring clear and effective communication. Enjoy working in a collaborative work environment with people from diverse backgrounds. This is an ideal position for those with not only data science and machine learning skills, but also cloud service engineering skills for developing, deploying, and operating these critical ML products. Responsibilities Design and develop ML products to be integrated with our CDP. Own specific technical areas, drive and execute ML product projects, track progress and mitigate risks by collaborating closely with product managers, UX designers, architects, engineers, and stakeholders from other cross-functional teams. Play a key role in defining system architecture for the ML products and implementing specific components to enhance the user experience. Design and implement performant, scalable ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines, considering an ML model’s lifecycle (training and inference). Take responsibility for technical problem solving and meeting ML product objectives creatively in ambiguous scenarios. Participate in the on-call rotation for production support. Drive best practices including ML research methodologies, coding standards, code reviews, source control management, development processes, build processes, testing and release, and operational excellence. Requirements Advanced degree in computer science, data science, machine learning, or related field, or equivalent work experience. 6+ years of professional experience in software engineering designing and building ML-driven products, with at least 3 years focused on production ML systems. Fundamental knowledge of Data Engineering and extensive experience in developing and deploying ML models, as well as building and maintaining ML pipelines and products. Experience in applying scientific method : hypothesis formulation and testing, exploratory data analysis, cross-validation, reproducible research, and structured reporting/documentation, result explanation and presentation. Experience designing, deploying, and operating scalable ML systems in production. This includes responsibility for model selection, performance benchmarking, and lifecycle management to solve real-world business problems. Proficiency in Python and general ML ecosystem tooling in data processing and modelling (such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.). Experience in designing and building products using public cloud services such as AWS. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, and ability to convey research findings and implications to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and distributed teams across different time zones. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience with security design principles and best practices. Experience working with big data technologies such as Hive, Trino, Spark, BigQuery, and Redshift. OSS contribution experiences.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Mobile - Android)
jobs.description: As Tech Lead / Android Developer, you will take over the Android version of the Queri app, our flagship product, owning the native codebase end to end: architecture, implementation, releases, and quality. You will work directly with the CTO and closely with the CEO, designers, and the rest of the team to plan features, ship them to production, and keep the app fast, stable, and loved by fans and creators. We are a small team that ships quickly, and AI-assisted development is how we work. Claude Code and Claude Design are used daily across the company, and you will be expected to use them as force multipliers. That said, we are not looking for vibe coders. You should have deep experience shipping native Android apps without AI assistance, and you are expected to understand every line of code that ships, whether you wrote it by hand or generated it with AI. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the technical direction for mobile, lead development as the team grows, and be the person responsible for everything that reaches the Play Store. Responsibilities Own the Queri Android app end to end: architecture, implementation, testing, releases, and Play Store operations. Lead the technical direction for mobile, making pragmatic decisions on architecture, libraries, and tooling. Plan, build, and ship new features on a regular cadence with the CEO, CTO, designers, and backend engineers. Keep the app fast, stable, and reliable, monitoring crashes and performance with Firebase and analytics tooling. Use analytics and product metrics to understand user behavior and inform what to build next. Build and maintain the app’s integrations with our APIs, push notifications, payments, and media pipelines. Use Claude Code and Claude Design daily to accelerate development, prototyping, and UI work. Review code, set engineering standards, and raise the bar for mobile quality across the company. Coordinate releases end to end: versioning, staged rollouts, store listings, and release notes. Help shape the roadmap for the iOS app alongside Android as our mobile footprint grows. Requirements 5+ years of professional native Android development experience. A track record of shipping and operating production Android apps on the Play Store. Experience shipping Android apps without AI assistance. You are expected to understand every line of code that ships, hand-written or AI-generated. Strong Kotlin skills and deep familiarity with the modern Android stack. Comfortable using analytics and Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, or similar) to monitor and improve a live app. Daily working proficiency with Claude Code and Claude Design. AI-assisted development is our standard. A self-starter who can own a product area with minimal direction. Professional working English. Japanese is not required. Comfortable in a small, fast-moving startup environment. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Web or React Native experience. Experience being in charge of an iOS app, as owner or lead. Experience in entertainment, creator economy, or fan community products. Experience with payments, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Experience with mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane, or similar). Experience working with international teams and global consumer products.

jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description <仕事内容> 大手半導体メーカーを始めとする取引先企業の工場内で当社製の半導体製造装置の検査・点検、保守サービスとメンテナンスを担当。 まずは1ヶ月の基礎技術研修終了後、ある程度の技量が身につくまで、先輩からのOJTにて業務を覚えていただきます。その後、手順書に従って装置の定期点検や部品の洗浄、消耗パーツの交換等、決められた業務を複数人とチームを組んで作業します。 技術的な素養がなくても、問題なく仕事を覚えることができる環境です。 また、業務内容が大きく変わることがないため、安心して作業に取り組むことができます。業務を覚えて自信がついたら、自分の頑張り次第で次のステップに上がることも可能です。チームリーダーや高度な不具合対応等、あなたの力を必要としている業務はたくさんあります。 ≪ワークライフバランス≫ 勤務時間は配属先のチームにより異なりますが、日の実働が 7.5~11時間 のシフト制となります。夜勤を含む 3勤3休シフト や 4勤2休 などがあり、勤務日数はシフトによって異なります。日勤帯のシフトと比較すると、給与や休日が増えるため、自分に合ったライフスタイルを大切にできます。 転勤はありませんので、腰を据えたお仕事と生活ができます。 <1日の流れ(例)> 8:00 朝会 8:30 工場内移動 9:00 作業開始 11:30 昼食 12:30 作業再開 16:00 帰宅 <入社後の流れ> ▼3日間 オリエンテーション ▼1ヶ月間 基礎技術研修 ▼その後は先輩の指導の下、現場で少しずつ経験を積んでいきます。 ★社内公募制度を使って、カスタマーエンジニア等に進むことも可能です。 また、透明性と公平性の高い評価制度により、収入アップやキャリアアップを実現できます。 ≪身につくスキル≫ 保守マニュアルによるメンテナンス作業からのスタートとなります。不具合対応のサポト業務等技術レベルを上げる業務に挑戦することでカスタマーエンジニアを目指すという道も。 キャリアアップをすれば、給与は確実に上がっていきます。半導体に関する知識がない方でも研修やサポートが充実しているので安心してご応募ください! <以下のいずれかの方は歓迎いたします> ・エンジニア未経験でも、ものづくりにご興味がある方 ・土日休みや有休消化率が高い企業で、ワークライフバランスを求めている方 ・半導体・ディスプレイ業界にご興味がある方 ・機械系の保守や整備、保全、修理、サービスエンジニア、アフターサービスのお仕事にご興味がある方 ・設備メンテナンスや設備管理、設備工事、工場でのお仕事にご興味がある方 ・理系学部卒業者(機械、工業、電気、電子、化学、物理などの学科) <勤務時間> 9時〜21時の間でシフト制勤務(実働時間7.5時間・休憩1時間) <平均残業時間> 月平均10時間 <給与> 月給:29万0000円~万39万0000円 ※経験・能力を考慮し決定 <福利厚生> 社保完備 インセンティブ制度 自己啓発援助金(英会話スクール、技術セミナーなど) 社宅制度(転勤時) 社員持株会 ストックアワード(自社株の付与制度) 退職金制度 他 <応募資格> ・JLPT N2以上の会話力をお持ちの方 Job Description You will be responsible for inspecting, maintaining, and servicing our semiconductor manufacturing equipment at the production facilities of major semiconductor manufacturers and other client companies. After completing a one-month basic technical training program, you will receive on-the-job training (OJT) from experienced team members until you become familiar with the work. Once you are ready, you will perform routine maintenance according to established procedures, including periodic equipment inspections, parts cleaning, and replacement of consumable components. Most tasks are carried out as part of a team. No prior technical experience is required. Our comprehensive training program and support system allow you to develop the necessary skills with confidence. Since the job responsibilities remain relatively consistent, you can build your expertise steadily over time. As your skills improve, you will have opportunities to advance into positions such as Team Leader or Customer Engineer, where you will handle more advanced troubleshooting and technical support. Work-Life Balance Working hours vary depending on your assigned team. Shift schedules typically range from 7.5 to 11 hours per day, including schedules such as: 3 days on / 3 days off (including night shifts) 4 days on / 2 days off Depending on your shift schedule, you may receive higher pay and enjoy more days off compared to standard daytime schedules, allowing you to choose a work style that best fits your lifestyle. No relocation is required, so you can build a stable career and personal life in one location. Example Daily Schedule 8:00 AM – Morning meeting 8:30 AM – Move to the work area inside the factory 9:00 AM – Begin maintenance work 11:30 AM – Lunch break 12:30 PM – Resume work 4:00 PM – Finish work and go home Training Program First 3 Days Company orientation First Month Basic technical training After Training Receive hands-on OJT with experienced technicians. Gradually take on more responsibilities as your skills develop. Employees can also apply through our internal job posting system to advance to positions such as Customer Engineer. Our transparent and fair performance evaluation system provides excellent opportunities for both career growth and salary increases. Career Development You will begin by performing maintenance work according to standard maintenance manuals. As your experience grows, you can take on technical support and equipment troubleshooting responsibilities, ultimately progressing toward a Customer Engineer position. The more your skills develop, the greater your earning potential. Even if you have no prior knowledge of the semiconductor industry, our comprehensive training and support will help you succeed. Preferred Qualifications We welcome applicants who are: Interested in manufacturing, even without engineering experience Looking for a company that values work-life balance and offers generous paid leave Interested in the semiconductor or display manufacturing industry Interested in careers involving machine maintenance, equipment repair, facility maintenance, service engineering, or after-sales service Interested in factory maintenance, facility management, or industrial equipment Graduates of science or engineering disciplines (Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Industrial Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, etc.) Working Hours Shift work between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM Actual working hours: 7.5 hours per day Break: 1 hour Average Overtime Approximately 10 hours per month Salary Monthly Salary: JPY 290,000 – JPY 390,000 Salary will be determined based on experience and skills. Benefits Comprehensive social insurance Performance incentive program Self-development allowance (English language courses, technical seminars, etc.) Company housing support (when relocation is required) Employee stock ownership plan Stock Award Program (company stock grants) Retirement plan Additional employee benefits Requirements Japanese language proficiency of JLPT N2 level or above with conversational communication skills. 本求人は、総合人材サービスを展開する「株式会社foredge(フォレッジ)」が保有する、一般には公開されていない限定求人です。 株式会社foredge(フォレッジ)は外国籍人材の就職・生活をトータルサポートする人材紹介会社です。 企業名や詳しい勤務条件、組織の雰囲気等については、ご応募後に当社の担当コンサルタントより個別にご案内いたします。 This is an exclusive, unlisted job opening managed by foredge Co., Ltd., a comprehensive human resources service provider. We are a recruitment agency dedicated to providing total support for global talents, assisting with both your career and your life in Japan. Due to the confidential nature of this position, details such as the company name, specific working conditions, and company culture will be shared with you individually by our dedicated consultant after you apply.

jobs.description: メディア運営・マーケティング・生成AIを活用した新規サービスの立ち上げを、事業の中核として推進していただきます(担当領域は適性とご本人の希望に応じて決定します)。 私たちは、メディア運営、とくにマーケティング領域で培ってきた知見を活かし、生成AIによってメディアやサービスを複数立ち上げ、影響力を最大化していきます。3つ目の席に座る人は、その立ち上げを「自分ごと」として担います。決められた業務をこなすのではなく、何をやるかから一緒に決める。創業期にしか味わえない、事業を根っこからつくる経験がここにあります。 席が少ないということは、一人あたりの裁量と責任が桁違いに大きいということです。「言われたことをやる」ポジションではありません。何をやるべきかを自分で問い、決め、やり切る。そういう方と出会いたいと思っています。 【私たちが大切にする3つの価値観】 1. 本質を問う:「これは本来どうあるべきか」を、スキルより先に考え抜く。指示を待つのではなく、問いを立てる。 2. 妥協なき最高の仕事:小手先のテクニックを捨て、ユーザーにとって本当に価値あるものを届け切る。「相手の結果を出す」まで妥協しない。 3. 人×AIで増幅する:人ならではの勝ち筋を見つけ、AIでレバレッジをかける。最小で最大を創発し、世界中のワクワクを増幅させる。 単にタスクをこなすだけなら、いまや感情を持たないAIに任せたほうが速く、正確です。誰よりもAIを使い倒している私たちだからこそ、それでも人と働く理由を問い直しました。行き着いた答えは「熱狂」です。同じ方向を向き、熱狂しながら一緒に未来をつくる。その一点で、私たちはあなたと働きたいと思っています。

jobs.description: ヘッドハンターの仕事には、2つの重要な側面があります。 一つは、クライアント企業の経営課題に深く切り込み、その事業を加速させるキーパーソンを外部から見つけ出し、参画へと導くことで、クライアント企業の成長に貢献すること。もう一つは、スカウトの対象となる候補者様の人生に寄り添い、その方が目指す理想のキャリアを共に実現していく「生涯のパートナー」であることです。 『企業が爆発的に成長し、一人の人生が輝き出す』この2つを高い次元で両立させることが、イコールチャンスのヘッドハンターのお仕事です。 具体的な業務内容: ・クライアント企業から経営課題の抽出、採用ニーズの掘り起こし、採用対象の要件定義 ・クライアントの課題に対応したプロジェクト設計、スカウト戦略の立案 ・スカウト対象者へのスカウト、インタビュー、求人案件のご提案 ・候補者様の履歴書・職務経歴書の作成支援、クライアントへの推薦 ・面接調整、各面接前後のフォロー、内定条件の交渉、退職交渉サポート、入社後フォロー ※未経験でも、この仕事に興味がある方は是非ご応募ください。はじめはわからないことばかりかと思いますが、できることを少しずつ増やしながら、一人前のヘッドハンターを目指しましょう。成長したいという強い気持ちをお持ちの方には、経験値10年以上の先輩ヘッドハンターが、あなたの成長を責任を持って支えますので、安心して飛び込んできてください。
