jobs.title: *Kumamoto* August Start, Full-Time Teacher Position for International School (Kindergarten)
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Attach a recent photo of you Visa sponsorship available Description [**August Start** Full-Time Teacher Position in Kumamoto city] Maple Tree International School is looking for a teacher who is passionate about early childhood education and eager to inspire young learners! We are a Cambridge-certified international school with a unique and innovative curriculum that nurtures children’s English ability, curiosity, and independent thinking skills. Our small class sizes create a warm and supportive environment where teachers can truly connect with students and help them gain the confidence to step into a global future. With a fun, friendly, and cozy atmosphere, our school is not just a place to teach—it’s a place to grow, create, and be part of something meaningful. If you’re ready to bring your energy, creativity, and love for teaching into a school that values your voice and celebrates your growth, we’d love to hear from you! Let’s create something meaningful together—at Maple Tree International School. [ Position Details ] *School Location: Sadowara, Higashi-Ku, Kumamoto city, Kumamoto *Teaching classes: English-immersion preschool/kindergarten, After school program for International kindergarten graduates *Students' age: 1.6 ~6 years old(Kindergarten), Elementary School students *Work Hours: 8:30-18:00 (60-minutes Lunch break, taken separately from the students) *Work Days: Monday to Friday *Starting Date: August, 2026 (*Negotiable) *Monthly Salary:280,000- 300,000yen (*It depends on the work schedule. Details will be explained in the interview. There are opportunities to earn additional income) *Social Insurances and Paid Holidays *Regular Days off: National Holidays, Saturdays and Sundays *G.W. Holidays/ Summer Obon holidays/ Year-end & New Years Holidays *Visa sponsorship available [ Qualifications ] -Native English speaker(Candidates must be from English speaking countries) -Teaching experience preferably at International preschools/kindergartens, eikaiwa schools -Bachelor's degree in Education or early childhood education, TESOL,or any teaching license and certificate is a plus -Basic PC skills(Word/Excel/Powerpoint, ipads, Mac PCs) -Conversational Japanese skill(Not necessary) *We are looking for passionate, dedicated teachers to join our team! At our school, we believe in creating a nurturing and inspiring environment where both children and teachers can thrive. Ideal candidates; -Truly love working with very young children and enjoy teaching across all age groups -Understand children’s unique characteristics, interests, and learning styles -Have formally studied and understand Early Childhood Education theory. -Understand TEFL/TESOL teaching methods.(Know how to teach ESL children right away) -Be genuinely passionate about teaching and committed to education -Show responsibility, dedication, punctuality, and professionalism in their work -Bring a fun, friendly, and energetic personality to the classroom -Demonstrate patience, kindness, and encouragement with every child -Have a high Emotional Quotient(EQ) and good people skills. -Work collaboratively as a supportive and positive team member -Respect students, parents, colleagues, and staff at all times -Listen to feedback and incorporate these suggestions into your work routines. -Have an understanding of Japanese culture, manners, customs, and work ethics -Be able to design engaging lesson plans and conduct lessons aligned with the school curriculum -Contribute actively to the growth and development of the school community -Already be residing in Japan If you are enthusiastic about early childhood education, eager to inspire young learners, and ready to be part of a supportive and international team, we would love to hear from you! *Hiring Process 1. Interview & Mini demo lesson via Zoom 2. jobs.title: Hotel and Food & Beverage Staff
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: None Visa Sponsorship: Future possibility / Renewal Valid Working holiday visa Preference given to: Native English speakers from British Commonwealth countries Job Description British Hills, an English Village set upon mountains in Fukushima prefecture, is currently seeking several hospitality staff for our hotel. Job Description Have you ever wanted to live in Japan, but thought it could never happen without a degree? If you are between the ages of 18-30, you can apply for a Working Holiday Visa in Japan. Come live and work an top of a mountain in beautiful Fukushima! Shifts are flexible, so that you can make money while still being able to travel and experience Japanese culture. We are a resort, as well as a learning center. We offer classes for students and school groups, as well as fine dining and other luxuries for our guests. There are many positions available, ranging from food and beverage, to hospitality. Once employed, we offer lots of perks for our staff: free accommodation free meals health insurance and many more extras! If this sounds like something that might interest you, please submit your application online. British Hills is a resort hotel and educational facility set in the forested Hatori National Park, Fukushima, 1000 meters above sea level. Among this 60-acre village is a Victorianesque manor house, a traditional tea room, eight guest houses and the Barracks which also accommodates guests. What is the hourly rate of pay? Hourly pay is 1,200 yen. During the summer there is a lot of opportunity to gain extra hours by offering to work in other departments. Overtime is paid at 1.25 times the regular hourly rate (1,438 yen an hour). The pay system for service staff consists of four 7-day blocks during which the aim is to work 40 hours a block. Our pay period runs from the 16th of one month to the 15th of the next with payday being the 25th of that month. How long is the contract and is there a bonus? The standard contract length is 6 months but can be extended to one year for service staff on Working Holiday visas. Staff who choose to extend their contract for a further 6 months will receive a pay rise, bringing their basic hourly rate to hourly rate of 1,200 yen an hour. We provide an end-of-contract bonus for all service staff. Upon completion of your initial six month contract you will be awarded a bonus of 60,000 yen. This may be taken as a cash bonus, or if you are extending your contract with us, as 10 days paid holiday. In addition, employees who extended their contract receive an end-of-contract bonus of 75,000 yen at the end of the 12-month period of employment with British Hills. Paid holidays? In Japan paid holidays are notoriously few in all companies. However, you will receive 5 days paid holiday for first 6-month contract in accordance with the British Hills Rules and Regulations. Number of days off a month? Usually 9 days during each pay. (February is for 8 days) Medical Care Enrollment in Social Insurance System in Japan You are obliged to enroll in one of the health insurance system and pension system. At British Hills, you shall be covered by the Employees’ Health Insurance system, regardless of your nationality. The Employees’ Health Insurance system provides you with insurance benefits for sickness, injury, childbirth or death. And also you shall be covered by the Employees’ Pension Insurance system, regardless of your nationality.

You own a Japanese phone number and a local bank account / Japan Post Tattoos / piercings must be covered Description Join the team at Benesse BE studio! 🍎 We are excited to announce the opening of our brand-new Makuhari Bay Park Plaza! This is a unique opportunity to be part of our opening team and help create a welcoming, inspiring learning environment from day one. As an opening teacher, you'll do more than teach lessons—you'll play an important role in shaping the school, sharing ideas, and creating a place where children and their families love to come. Who We Are Looking For: ・ Instructors who prioritize motivation and fun over memorization. ・ Energetic individuals who love teaching children. ・ Eager candidates currently in or moving to the Greater Tokyo Area. Advantages of BE Studio The Setup: ・ Ready-to-Go: Lesson plans provided. ・ Support System: Work alongside a Japanese lesson partner in every plaza. ・ Small Classes: Maximum of 8 students per lesson. ・ Fun First: Game-focused learning that children enjoy. The Schedule: ・ Work-Life Balance: 35-hour work week. ・ Ample Lesson Prep Time: "No Lesson Days" for training, prep, or vacation. ・ Reliability: Fixed yearly schedule with the same students (for regular teachers). ・ Time Off: National holidays usually off + 10 company holidays + 10 paid leave days. ・ Bonus Rest: "Happy Mondays" special paid leave available in some cases. Perks: ・ No Japanese language required. ・ Transportation costs fully covered. ・ Health & Security: Social insurance (Shakai Hoken) + Benesse’s extra insurance scheme. ・ Growth: Dedicated team to support you individually & ongoing training. ・ We are open to discuss relocation allowance. Why Choose BE studio? As part of Benesse Holdings—a leader in Japan’s education industry—we offer the support you need to thrive: ・ Stability & Growth: Reliable employment with a household name. ・ Full Support: Visa sponsorship in some cases & comprehensive benefits. ・ Meaningful Work: Be a vital part of a child’s developmental journey. About BE studio: BE studio values students' "BE YOURSELF" and "WANT TO BE". 100 Students. 100 Stories. At BE studio, we know no two students are the same. We don’t just teach English; we build the bridge to the rest of the world. Our Goal: ・ Equip students to collaborate globally, communicate from the heart, & create real-world value. Different paths. One global future. ・ Longevity! We opened our first studio in 1975, decades of experience & proven success. ・ Diversity! Join a team of 400 teachers from 50 different countries. ・ Convenience! Work where life happens, our classrooms are generally near major transportation hubs. Contract type: Full Time Compensation ・ Full Time from 264,000 to 275,000 yen/month (Saturday & Sunday plus 3 week days). ・ Work hours: lessons are generally between 9:00- 21:00 (different work shifts). ・ Work schedule: Generally, 7 work hours/day. Job Description: ・ Work days: 5 ・ Days off: 2 ・ Work hours: 35 hours per week ・ Deliver 50, 60, 70 or 90 minute group lessons (maximum of 8 students / class). ・ Prepare for the lessons (review lesson plans, clean up materials, tidy up the room etc.). ・ Work with Japanese lesson partner to provide high quality lessons and customer service. ・ Deliver special lessons and participate in seasonal events. ・ All lesson plans are provided and the materials will be ready at each classrooms. Qualification/requirements: ・ Native-level English ・ Bachelor's degree (per immigration) & a valid work visa. ・ You must be in Japan now and ready to interview in Tokyo (No tourist/temp visa) ・ Must own a Japanese phone number & a local bank account. ・ Decency: Tattoos/piercing must be covered. The Schedule & Commute: ・ Availability: Ready for Saturdays and Sundays ・ On the Move: Commutes up to 60 minutes (Regular) or 90 minutes (Substitution). ・ Experience: Eikaiwa experience is a plus, but we’ll train the right person!

jobs.title: Kindergarten and Elementary English Teacher
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Conversational Must currently reside in Japan One year experience teaching children Musical ability Must enjoy working with children Description Max English is looking for a lively, fun loving individual to teach English classes at a Japanese kindergarten in Kiyose (North Tokyo, Seibu Ikebukuro line) from October 2026. We run two sets of classes: fun orientated morning classes for kindergarten aged children, and study orientated classes in the afternoon for both kindergarten and elementary aged children. The position is full-time 40 hours per week with 18-22 teaching hours, Mon-Fri with some events on Saturdays (a day in lieu will be scheduled). As well as teaching, other duties include eating lunch and playing with the children, and helping out at school events. Applicants must have at least one year of experience teaching children (ideally in Japan), though training will be provided. Applicants must love children, be in sound health, be energetic, be adaptable and organized, and be entertaining. As we use a lot of songs in our curriculum, the ability to sing is a must, and being able to play the piano or guitar would be a bonus. Native English ability and conversational Japanese are also required. Teachers at Max English work as a team and importance is placed on a good team dynamic. Our teachers also possess a good work ethic, are punctual and are ready to work a full year. All applicants must be presently residing in Japan to be considered, and as we run try-out sessions at the school, the position would be best suited for those living in the Tokyo or Saitama area. Applicants must also have a valid working visa to start however the company will assist in any renewal procedures after employment has begun. Pay is between 270,000-300,000 Japanese Yen per month and will be set depending on experience and perceived potential. Health insurance, pension and employment insurance are provided, transportation to and from work is paid and there is also a very generous holiday package. Housing allowance is not offered. The contract is for one year and can be renewed. If you think you fit the bill and have what it takes to join the Max English team, please apply with a resume/CV, covering letter and a photo. Interviews will take place through July and August and try-out sessions at the school will be held from late August to mid September. The successful instructor will start training in October before moving on to solo-teaching.

jobs.title: TIS Afterschool Teacher in Tokyo
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Must have a university degree Must have at least 2 years experience teaching children in Japan Must be professional, hard working, passionate, energetic and love working with children Visa sponsorship available Description Students break into applause as the presenter, standing at the front of the class, finishes describing their artwork to the group. You ask the class, "Does anyone have any questions or comments?" Eager hands immediately shoot up. Asking a student in the front row, they comment, "I like the color you chose." Heads nod in agreement. You make a quick note on your iPad about the 21st-century skills that the students are displaying and move on to the next student waiting to present. Established in 1985, Tokyo International School Group (TISG) runs Tokyo International School Afterschool (TISAS), Tokyo International School Kindergarten (TISKG) and Tokyo International School Learning Through English (TISLTE) at our Nakameguro, Minamiazabu, Komazawa, Gakugeidai, and Shukugawa model schools. We also have franchise campuses based in Tokyo (Kachidoki) and Sapporo (Maruyama). With the opening of a new Kindergarten at our Minamiazabu campus, we are currently looking to hire three TISAS teachers and a TISKG teacher to start as soon as possible at our Tokyo locations. TISKG is a three-year international kindergarten program that provides an immersion environment that services a wide range of Japanese and international families. Students attend classes from 9:00 am until 2 pm. TISAS is an Afterschool program that provides an immersion environment for predominantly non-native English-speaking children. Students attend classes from 4 pm until 7 pm. POSITION DETAILS AND BENEFITS The workweek is Monday to Friday. Paid time off includes: - Saturday and Sunday - Public holidays - Summer and winter holiday - Flexible leave is also included. The daily work schedule is: - 8:00 to 16:00 or 8:30 to 16:30 for TISKG (depending on class level) or - 11:30 to 19:30 for TISAS. This includes: - 1.5 hours of prep per day - 1 hour break The monthly salary is 277,500 to 295,00 per month depending on the program. Wage growth from the second contract is possible based on performance. Transportation will be fully reimbursed. IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for a confident, dedicated, and passionate teacher. Candidates must have a university degree and two years of experience (ideally working with young learners in Japan). LOCATION Afterschool positions are located at our model schools near Gakugeidaigaku station, Shirokanetakanawa station, and our franchise school near Kachidoki station, while the TISKG position is located near Shirokanetakanawa. To be clear, teachers are assigned to a single campus. START DATE As soon as possible, with classes beginning on August 24. RECRUITMENT PROCESS - We will screen resumes to check that the minimum requirements are met. - Candidates will be contacted to arrange online interviews. - Following the first round of interviews, candidates will be short-listed for a second round of interviews, which may include a trial lesson. - Candidates will be asked to bring their residence cards, passports, copies of qualifications, and letters of reference when attending the trial lesson. - At the completion of the second round of interviews, a decision will be made. - Once that final decision has been made, we will contact all candidates to inform them of the decision. - The successful candidate will then meet with us again to sign employment documentation. We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.description: 【ミッション】 クラウド労務ソフト「FORROU(フォロー)」を契約した社会保険労務士(社労士)事務所に対し、システムが本格的に実務で活用・定着されるまで伴走することがミッションです。一般的な「問い合わせを待つ」カスタマーサポートとは根本的に異なり、利用データをもとに「自ら動く」能動的なサクセス活動を行います。 【具体的な業務内容】 1.利用状況データの分析 契約事務所のFORROU利用状況(ログイン頻度、活用機能、登録人数・従業員数の推移など)を定期的にチェックします。「契約から3ヶ月経過しているが、給与計算機能が使われていないのはなぜか?」など、データから仮説を立てることが仕事の起点となります。 2.お客様への能動的なアプローチ・提案 分析結果に基づき、お客様へ自らアプローチを行います。「御事務所の給与計算業務は、FORROUのこの機能を使うことでここまで効率化できます」といった具体的な活用提案を、オンライン(個別Zoomデモやテーマ別のウェビナー企画・実施)を中心に実施します。 3.課題の言語化と開発チームへのフィードバック お客様が抱える給与計算や手続き業務の課題をヒアリングして言語化し、FORROUを用いた解決策を提示します。同時にお客様のリアルな声を構造的にまとめ、製品改善に向けて社内の開発チームへフィードバックします。 【入社後の流れ・サポート体制】 最初の1〜2ヶ月間は、社内に併設されている社労士法人にて研修を行います。実務を間近で見ながら社労士業務の基礎知識と製品知識をじっくり身につけられます。その後は先輩社員のサポートを受けながら、徐々にサクセス業務へと移行します。いきなり一人ですべてをお任せすることはありませんのでご安心ください。 【評価方針】 全社共通の方針として、定性的な評価はなく、目標・成果をすべて数値でクリアに評価します。カスタマーサクセスにおいては、担当するFORROUの「登録人数(従業員数)」が主な評価指標となります。

jobs.description: 社内外のステークホルダー(経営層・営業・CS・顧客)から上がる要件を整理・設計 し、グループ開発チームへ確実につなぐ、上流工程全般をお任せします。 【主な業務内容】 ・ステークホルダーヒアリング(経営層・営業・CS・顧客など) ・要件整理・要件定義書の作成 ・仕様策定・システム設計(業務フロー、システム構成など) ・グループ開発チームへの仕様連携・調整 ・EPICの進捗管理・スケジュール管理 ・WBS作成・タスク管理 ・システム検証(テスト) ・COO/CTOへの進捗レポート ・関連ドキュメントの作成・管理 【開発業務について】 コーディングや実装はグループ会社の開発チームが担当します。本ポジションでは、事業部門の要望を整理し、要件定義・仕様設計に落とし込む上流工程を中心に担っていただきます。 【スキルセットについて】 本ポジションでは、特定のプログラミング言語・フレームワーク・開発ツールの使用経験は必須としていません。 特定の技術を扱えることではなく、Webサービスやシステム開発の仕組みを理解し、事業部門の要望を整理したうえで、要件定義や設計に落とし込み、開発チームと連携しながらプロジェクトを推進できることを重視しています。 これまでに使用してきた言語や技術環境が当社と異なる場合でも、Webサービスの開発・設計に携わった経験や、データベース設計をはじめとするシステム設計の基本的な考え方・ご経験があれば、十分にご活躍いただけます。

jobs.title: 商品企画営業(ライツ営業)
jobs.description: 【業務内容】 商品企画開発Divのメンバーとして、IPの魅力と事業成果を両立させながら、ライセンス元との関係性を起点にしにした商品開発の推進、新規商材開発の実務を担っていただきます。 単なる案件の進行管理にとどまらず、商品戦略を深く理解し、企画意図とライセンス元の意向を接続する「ハブ」となること、そして新商品発売時の販促施策までを横断的に見据え、条件交渉にとどまらず事業機会そのものを拡張していくことが、このポジションのミッションです。 【具体的な業務内容】 ▽入社直後(0〜3ヶ月) まずは既存案件のキャッチアップと、社内外の関係性・業務フローの理解からスタートしていただきます。 ・既存案件および主要ライセンス元(版元)との関係性の理解・棚卸 ・進行中案件のキャッチアップと、案件進行の一部実行 ・案件対応プロセスの可視化、および属人化させないための業務標準化・仕組み化の準備 ・案件ごとの優先順位や意思決定基準の明確化 ▽コア業務(3〜12ヶ月) 業務に慣れていただいた後は、ライセンス営業のコアメンバーとして、関係性強化や販促・プロモーションの推進まで幅広くお任せします。 ・主要ライセンス元との関係性強化、および定期的なコミュニケーション設計 ・新商品発売時における販促企画・施策(SNS・店舗施策など)の設計および実行推進 ・ファンを魅了するための販売プロモーション戦略の立案・実行 ▽将来的にお任せしたい業務 将来的には、事業のスケールや組織の成長を牽引する中心人物としての活躍を期待しています。 ・中長期的なIPポートフォリオ戦略の運用 ・ライセンス元との共創モデルの実行(“監修依頼先”から、共に価値を高める“事業パートナー”へのリレーション進化) ・国内外(台湾・シンガポール・ヨーロッパ圏など)を視野に入れたIP展開戦略の実行 【このポジションの魅力】 「調整・手続き」に留まらない、事業と仕掛けを組み立てる面白さ:単に版元から商品化の許諾(ライセンス)を取得するだけの受動的な営業ではありません。新商品の発売に合わせ、「どう話題化させ、どうファンに届けるか」という販促企画やプロモーション施策まで一気通貫で自ら設計・実行できる、非常に裁量の大きなポジションです。 作品の価値を共に高める「事業パートナー」としてのリレーション構築:アニメ、ゲーム、出版などのライセンス元(版元)に対し、単なる“監修の依頼先”を超えた存在として信頼を築いていく手応えがあります。エンタメコンテンツへの深いリスペクトを持ちながら、ビジネスとして売上・粗利を最大化させる共創モデルを自ら推進していく醍醐味を味わえます。 属人化を排し、急成長を支える「ヒットの構造」を創る経験:現在、会社は「売上30億円」という非連続な成長を目指すエキサイティングなフェーズにあります。増え続ける案件をただこなすのではなく、自身の力で営業プロセスを可視化・標準化し、組織としての「再現性のあるヒットの仕組み」へと昇華させる、組織変革のコアメンバーとしての経験を積むことができます。

jobs.title: 情シス(社内IT・AIインフラエンジニア)

jobs.description: 日本トレカセンターにおける社内IT環境、セキュリティ基盤、および全社的なAI利用インフラ(Cursor, Claude Code, MCPサーバー等)の設計・構築・運用を担当していただきます。 当社の情シスは、PCのキッティングやパスワード再発行の手続きをひたすら手作業で繰り返すレガシーなヘルプデスクではありません。AIを全従業員の「相棒」として機能させるため、最新のAIツールやiPaaS、セキュリティ製品を自在に組み合わせ、世界一生産性の高い『AIファーストな仕事環境』を技術的に構築することがミッションです。 【具体的な業務内容】 1. AI開発・利用環境のインフラ構築:全社で導入されているCursor、Claude Codeの最適化、およびAIが社内ナレッジ(Notion、GitHub等)にセマンティックにアクセスするためのMCP(Model Context Protocol)カスタムサーバーの運用・整備補助。 2. コーポレートITの自動化推進(ゼロタッチ):IntuneやJamfを用いたMac/Windowsのゼロタッチキッティング環境の構築。AI Opsチームと連携し、アカウント発行・削除の完全自動化ワークフロー(Make, 各種API連携)の設計。 3. クラウドセキュリティ・ID管理の高度化:Okta、Azure AD等を用いたシングルサインオン(SSO)の構築、ゼロトラストネットワークセキュリティ(エンタープライズブラウザ、EDR、SASE等)の導入・運用。 4. SaaSコスト・アカウントの最適化:社内で利用されている各種SaaSおよびLLM APIの利用状況の可視化、コスト最適化、セキュリティポリシーの策定と監視。 【本ポジションの魅力】 ChatGPT PlusやClaude Proの全社支給はもちろん、CursorやClaude Code、MCPといったエンジニアリング最前線のAI環境を、ビジネス職を含めた全社インフラとして設計・社会実装するという、世界でもトップクラスにエキサイティングなチャレンジが可能です。手作業を徹底的に排除した「自動化された情シス」のモデルケースを自ら創り上げることができます。

jobs.title: After-school program English teacher (Kanto) – visa and housing support available
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: None Visa Sponsorship: Future possibility / Renewal English proficiency at a native level Team-oriented, friendly, and able to adapt to a highly active work environment Previous work experience in childcare, teaching, or related fields is preferred Minimum of a two-year associate degree (or equivalent) or an unrestricted working visa Job Description As one of the biggest education companies in Japan, Yaruki Switch Group has been changing lives for more than 40 years. Join our team as a teacher with our Kids Duo brand and empower young children to build language abilities, self-confidence, and a lifelong love of learning. YARUKI Switch Group has directly managed and franchise locations. Directly managed schools are owned and operated by YARUKI Switch Group. Franchise locations are owned and run by independent owners who have an agreement with YARUKI Switch Group. Now hiring in the following areas: Tokyo Kanagawa Tochigi Ibaraki ◆ What’s in It for You? Starting salary: ¥250,000–270,000 depending on experience Raise opportunities based on school performance Ten paid days of leave per year (after six months of employment), in addition to national holidays ¥100,000 contract-renewal bonus upon successful completion of the contract Fully paid initial training, including accommodation and transportation reimbursement Work-related commuting costs reimbursed Social Security and Health Insurance provided Visa sponsorship and renewal support available Support with securing housing, opening bank accounts, and more * Some contract details may vary depending on location. ◆ Kids Duo: Teaching through creativity and fun Kids Duo focuses on fostering students’ confidence and abilities in English via interactive games and activities. Our motto is “Play in English, learn in English.” We create fun, safe, and comfortable environments where our students learn real, usable English. Kids Duo teachers lead large and small groups of students (ages 3 to 12) in a variety of highly active games and activities. This includes arts and crafts, music and dance, social studies, outdoor programs, and more. ◆ Teachers While we support teachers with an established curriculum and lesson plans, successful teachers grow and expand on these foundations by providing their own unique and original games and lesson ideas. Our approach allows for ample creative freedom to personalize your teaching style and inject passion and enthusiasm into your class. Working shifts are nine hours (including one-hour lunch break). Shifts generally fall between the hours of 9:00 to 20:00 from Monday to Friday (some weekend work may be required). Established in 2011, we operate premium CBD Shops & Cafés in some of Tokyo’s most exciting retail destinations. We are currently looking for a friendly, energetic, and internationally minded Sales Associate to join our retail team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys customer interaction, wellness products, premium retail, and communicating with both international and Japanese customers. Depending on the day, you may have the opportunity to work between our Harakado location at Tokyu Plaza Harajuku and our Marui location in Shinjuku, two of Japan’s leading tourism and commercial areas. Through this experience, you will interact with a wide variety of customers and further develop and refine your sales skills. Responsibilities Welcome and assist customers in English and Japanese Explain and recommend CBD, wellness, and food products Support sales growth through excellent customer engagement Operate POS/register and handle daily shop operations Maintain attractive product displays and shop cleanliness Help manage inventory and stock replenishment Support promotional activities and sampling events Occasionally assist café operations when needed Requirements Conversational Japanese and English ability Friendly, professional, and proactive personality Interest in wellness, natural products, or premium retail Comfortable communicating with overseas visitors and Japanese customers Team player with a positive attitude Retail or hospitality experience preferred Candidates must currently possess a valid visa allowing employment in Japan Preferred Experience in premium retail, hospitality, or wellness brands Experience working with international customers Interest in plant-based foods or CBD/wellness products Employment Type Full-time preferred Part-time candidates will also be considered Visa sponsorship is not available for this position Locations Harakado (Tokyu Plaza Harajuku) Shinjuku Marui About HealthyTOKYO HealthyTOKYO has been a pioneer in CBD and plant-based wellness in Japan for nearly a decade. In addition to CBD products, we are known for our natural, vegan, and gluten-free foods and operate some of Japan’s best-known CBD retail locations. We pride ourselves on offering high-quality products, excellent customer experiences, and a welcoming international atmosphere.

jobs.title: Platform Quality Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for passionate Platform Quality Engineer to join KOMOJU’s growing QA team. In this hybrid role, you will contribute to both automated and manual testing efforts to ensure the reliability, functionality, and performance of our payment systems. As an Platform Quality Engineer, you will help shape and drive QA processes from the ground up. You will be working cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to define and measure quality at every level of our stack. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and is eager to grow their technical and testing skills. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and tools to improve test coverage and reliability. Execute and manage manual, exploratory, and regression testing for new features and releases. Analyze system specifications and technical requirements to provide feedback and ensure testability. Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution, contributing to improved product quality. Support the team by building and maintaining CI/CD test pipelines and integrating automated tests into release workflows. Collaborate with developers to ensure proper testing is done throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in code reviews and test plan reviews. Help establish quality processes and best practices across the engineering team. Investigate and recommend tools or practices that help scale QA and improve team productivity. Requirements 2–5 years of experience in software testing, automation, or software development. Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby). Hands-on experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Capybara, or RSpec. Strong understanding of testing methodologies including unit, integration, and E2E testing. Experience writing and executing test plans and test cases, both automated and manual. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and test automation integration. Ability to work independently in ambiguous environments with a strong bias toward action. Excellent communication and debugging skills. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience testing multilingual or mobile applications. Familiarity with AWS, Datadog or performance testing. Exposure to backend systems, APIs or infrastructure. Experience working in Agile or fast-paced startup environments. Open-source contributions. Experience working with agile teams or in fast-paced startup environments. Open-source contributions.

jobs.title: English Homeroom Teacher
jobs.company: Seto SOLAN Primary School - 瀬戸SOLAN小学校
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Elementary teaching experience of at least two (2) years either in your home country or within Japan (Not necessary for new graduates of accredited universities) Willingness and ability to abide by and implement our English learning, problem solving, Inquiry-based curriculum Must currently reside in Japan Willingness and ability to work for at least three (3) years Visa sponsorship available Description Name of the School: Seto SOLAN Primary and Secondary school Position: English Homeroom Teacher (Full Time, Three months probationary period) We are a Japanese private elementary school (based on the Japanese national curriculum) and not functioning as an independent international school or an English conversation (Eikaiwa) school. The English Homeroom Teacher position requires teaching children in grades 1-9 and working together with a counterpart Japanese homeroom teacher. Responsibilities include: conducting morning and closing meetings, planning their own lessons, and supporting learning of other subjects in English. In addition, the successful candidate should have a broad understanding of Japanese school workplace culture and professional expectations, demonstrate flexibility in a fast-paced environment, and possess a proactive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility. They should be willing to take initiative in carrying out additional duties assigned by the school. Most importantly, they should demonstrate respect for people of all cultures, ethnicities, and backgrounds. We focus on: ・Problem solving and inquiry-based learning ・Utilizing ICT ・Developing English language acquisition Remuneration: Base Salary:¥260,000~¥320,000 per month (Salary varies depending on qualification and experience) Bonus: Summer and Winter (1 month each), paid at 50%–150% depending on company performance and individual performance. Other Benefits include: Transportation expenses: maximum of ¥20,000 per month (varies according to distance) OR Rent subsidy: maximum of ¥30,000 per month (This is only available for teachers who opt to live within the schools proximity) *You may receive rent subsidy or transportation expenses, not both. Also Moving expenses: Negotiable Visa sponsorship: Available Qualifications/Requirements: -Bachelor's degree or higher -Elementary teaching experience of at least two (2) years either in your home country or within Japan (Not necessary for new graduates of accredited universities) -Middle or High School experience in Japan will also be considered as we have opened a Secondary School division in April 2025 -Willingness and ability to abide by and implement our English learning, problem solving, Inquiry-based curriculum - Possess experience and/or qualification in TEFL/TESL/TESOL Desired, but non-mandatory qualifications: • Possess an accredited Elementary School license (Middle or High School license will also be considered) • Willingness and ability to work for at least three (3) years • Experience teaching their subject specialization SUBJECT AREA: English, Life Studies (Science/Social Studies for lower grades), Physical Education, Music, Art • English: Native or Native level • Must currently reside in Japan • Bachelor's degree or higher • Elementary school teaching experience (Middle or High School experiences will also be considered) • Demonstrate an understanding and interest in Japanese culture and language. (No Japanese skill necessary) Preference will be given to those candidates who submit the following requirements (items 12) through our e-mail address: recruit@seto-solan.ed.jp 1 A one page double spaced statement of purpose why you are applying to our school 2 Two double spaced pages essay demonstrating your language learning experience and teaching principle 3 Two reference contacts are required. ➃ Updated Resume *Important information* Deadline: As soon as the position is filled (rolling basis) Due to the large number of applications we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted. Previous applicants need NOT apply. Recruitment Process Document Screening, please submit required documents to recruit@seto-solan.ed.jp 1st Interview (online) 2nd Interview (in-person) - Demo lesson, and School Tour ※ For 1st interview passers only Offer ※ For 2nd interview passers only All communication between interviews will be done via email. 学校名:瀬戸SOLAN学園初等中等部 職種:ネイティブまたはネイティブレベルの小学校教師 (フルタイム、3か月の試用期間) 当校は、日本の私立小学校(日本の学習指導要領に基づく)であり、独立したインターナショナルスクールや英会話スクールではありません。 小学校教師の担任教師の職種では、1年生から9年生までの児童を教え、日本人担任教師と協力して働く必要があります。また、小学校教師の担任教師は、朝のミーティングを実施し、個々の授業計画を立て、英語でそれぞれの科目を教えます。ただし、教師の職種や職務内容は個人のスキルとパフォーマンスをもとに決まりますので、ご理解ください。 さらに、応募者は、日本の学校の労働倫理と文化に対する幅広い理解、ペースの速い環境における柔軟性、強い責任感を持ったやる気のある姿勢、学校から割り当てられた他の職務に参加する積極性、そして何よりも、他の文化、民族、背景を尊重する姿勢を必要としています。 重点的に取り組んでいること: ・問題解決と探究型学習 ・ICTの活用 ・英語習得を促進 報酬: 基本給:月額260,000~320,000円 (資格や経験により給与は異なります) 夏季・冬季賞与(各1か月分)。会社の業績と個人のパフォーマンスにより、支給額は50%〜150%の範囲で変動。 その他の福利厚生: 交通費:月額最大20,000円 または 家賃補助:月額最大30,000円(学校の近くに住むことを選択した教師のみ利用可能) その他 引っ越し費用:応相談 ビザスポンサーシップ:利用可能 *家賃補助または交通費のいずれかを受け取ることができます。両方を受け取ることはできません。 資格/要件: -学士号以上 -母国または日本国内で少なくとも2年間の小学校教育経験(認定大学の新卒者には不要) -2025年4月に中学校を開校したため、日本で中学校または高校の経験がある応募者も考慮されます -英語学習/問題解決/探究型カリキュラムを遵守し、実施する意欲と能力 -TEFL/TESL/TESOL/IELTSの経験および/または資格を有する 望ましい(ただし必須ではない) 資格: -認定小学校免許を有する(中学校または高校の免許も考慮されます) -少なくとも3年間働く意欲と能力 -専門科目の指導経験 科目領域:英語、生活科(低学年の社会/理科)、体育、音楽、図画工作 • 英語:ネイティブまたはネイティブレベル • 現在日本に居住している必要があります •学士号以上/現在、大学卒業以上 • 小学校での教育経験が2年以上(中学校または高校での経験も考慮されます) • 英語学習、問題解決、探究型の教育に意欲と能力 • 日本の文化と言語に対する理解と関心を示せること。(日本語スキルは不要) 以下の要件(項目12)を当校のメールアドレスrecruit@seto-solan.ed.jpに送信した候補者を優先します。 1 当校への応募理由をダブルスペースで1ページに記入 2 語学学習経験と教育理念をダブルスペースで2ページに記入したエッセイ 3 参考連絡先を2名分 ➃ 更新された履歴書 *特記事項* 締め切り: 採用枠が埋まり次第 (随時) 多数の応募をいただいているため、面接に適していると思われる応募者にのみ連絡いたします。 以前に応募した方は応募することはできません。

jobs.description: フリーランス・個人事業主向けの支援事業を立ち上げて約2年。数百名以上のエンジニアとお話しする中で、「もっと挑戦したい」「でも一歩踏み出す勇気が出ない」という声を数多く聞いてきました。 私たちは、そんなエンジニアの選択肢を増やしたいという想いから、新たに正社員SES事業をスタートします。 今回募集するのは、その"1人目のエンジニア"です。 決められた組織に入るのではなく、サービスや制度、組織文化まで一緒につくっていけるポジションです。開発だけでなく、事業・採用・マーケティング・経営にも携わりながら、新しいSESの形を一緒につくっていきませんか。 ■クライアントプロジェクトでの開発支援 ・Webサービス・業務システム・モバイルアプリなどの開発 ・要件定義~設計・実装・運用保守まで、ご経験に応じたフェーズを担当 ・ご希望のキャリアや身につけたいスキルを踏まえ、最適なプロジェクトへアサインします ■社内プロダクト・業務改善 ・社内で利用する新規システムの企画・開発(0→1) ・AIを活用した業務改善・自動化の推進 ・コーポレートサイトやサービスサイトなどのWeb開発 ・技術選定や開発フロー改善の提案・実施 ■事業づくり・経営への参画 ・正社員SES事業のサービス設計・改善 ・経営計画や事業戦略に関するディスカッション ・マーケティング施策の企画・実行・改善 ・新しいサービスや取り組みの企画立案 ■組織づくり・採用 ・エンジニア採用戦略の企画・改善 ・カジュアル面談や技術面接への参加 ・技術広報や勉強会・イベントの企画・運営 ・エンジニアが働きやすい組織づくり

jobs.description: 当社は、「注文が入ってから商品を作る」オンデマンドプリントの仕組みを、ITの力で支えている会社です。 ECサイトで入った注文データは、当社の生産管理システムへ自動連携され、工場で製造・出荷まで行われます。 本ポジションは、パートナー企業と社内各部署をつなぎ、プロジェクトマネージャーと営業要素の強いのポジショです。 クライアント側ではマーケティング施策や販売企画を実行し、当社はその実現を仕組み・製造の側面から支えます。本ポジションは、その橋渡し役として全体を動かす役割を担います。 ■業務詳細 クライアントのサービスやECが、当社のシステムを利用し注文が確実にできるか対応していき、売上げの最大化を目指していきます!(デザイン不備などCS部門が対応) クライアント例:SUZURI(GMO)/ユニクロ/Shopify利用D2Cブランドなど 1 プロジェクト推進 ・クライアントフォロー(受発注、納品など) ・売上状況の確認と改善提案 ・商品カテゴリ追加や加工方法拡張の提案 ※マーケティング施策自体はクライアント側が主導します。本ポジションは、それを実現可能な形に落とし込む役割です。 2 社内連携・ディレクション ・生産管理チームとの納期/仕様確認 ・営業事務との受注フロー調整 ・開発部門とのシステム仕様確認 ・デザイン不備や注文トラブル発生時の一次整理 社内外の関係者を横断し、「どうすればスムーズに回るか」を設計・推進します。 3 仕組み改善・最大化 ・注文フローの改善提案 ・業務の仕組み化・効率化 ・取扱商品の拡充による売上最大化 単なる営業ではなく、 「案件を取る人」ではなく「案件を回す人」。 「売る人」ではなく「実現させる人」。 担当企業は1人あたり約5社〜10社程度(会社規模で異なる) 各社の事業状況を理解し、製造・システム・事務を束ねながら、安定運用と成長の両立を実現します。 ITやものづくりの専門知識は入社後に習得可能です。 重要なのは、全体を俯瞰し、関係者を巻き込みながら前に進める力です。

jobs.title: システムエンジニア(リーダー候補)
jobs.company: 株式会社アイティサーフ
jobs.description: 我々はこれまで、都内や神奈川県を中心としたクライアント先で、システム開発や保守・運用を担ってきました。現場で地道に築き上げてきた信頼と確かな技術力が高く評価され、ありがたいことに、現在も新しいプロジェクトへの参画依頼やチーム規模拡大の打診が絶えません。市場からのニーズは今、かつてないほどに高まっており、会社としてさらなる事業拡大へと舵を切る絶好のチャンスを迎えています。 しかし、その大きなチャンスを前にして、私たちは今、非常に悔しい壁にぶつかっています。 それが、プロジェクトやチームを力強く牽引する【リーダーの不足】です。 現在の組織構成には大きな課題があります。それは、意欲にあふれる20代主体の「若手層」と、経験豊富な40代以上の「ベテラン層」に大きく二極化しており、その中間となる「若手とベテランの間の層」がすっぽりと抜け落ちてしまっていることです。 若手メンバーは成長意欲が高くエネルギーに満ちていますが、SESという環境の中で自分たちの力だけでクライアントと対等に渡り合い、プロジェクトを動かすにはまだ経験が足りません。 一方で、ベテラン層は既存の重要案件のコントロールや経営層に近い役割を担っており、複数の現場を飛び回る若手一人ひとりを密に引き上げ、付きっきりで育成するだけの現場のリソースが不足しているのが現状です。どれだけ魅力的な案件があっても、チームをまとめる責任者が足りずにお断りせざるを得ない。 この構造的な要因によって次のステップに進めない現状を、私たちは今、本気で打破したいと考えています。 ーー現場が離れていても、私たちは「一つのチーム」です。 それぞれが異なるクライアント先で活躍するSESだからこそ、当社は「社員同士の繋がり」を何よりも大切にしています。 そのため、月に1度の【帰社日】を設け、全員が顔を合わせる機会をしっかりと確保しています。 さらに帰社日の後には、希望者のみで集まる【懇親会】を開催!費用はすべて「全額会社負担」です。 参加は完全自由なので無理な強制は一切ありませんが、現場の垣根を越えて他愛のない話で盛り上がったり、技術的な情報交換をしたりと、毎回フラットで温かい盛り上がりを見せています。 こうした「いつでも帰ってこられる温かい自社」があるからこそ、エンジニアたちは安心して現場で仕事に集中できています。 ーー 会社の変革期だからこそ、あなた自身の「成長チャンス」も無限大です。 今回の採用は、単に欠員を補填する後ろ向きなものではありません。 会社の未来をガラリと変えるための、極めて重要な「攻めの採用」です。 あなたにお任せしたいリーダーのポジションは、将来の幹部候補としての道に直結しています。 これからあなたが若手を率いてチームを大きくし、新しい現場を開拓していくごとに、組織の拡大に伴う「新しい役職」や「新しいポスト」が次々と生まれます。 歴史のある大手企業のように、「上にポストが詰まっていて昇格できない」なんてことは一切ありません。 あなたの成果とリーダーシップに対しては、ポジションと待遇の両面でダイレクトに応えていくことをお約束します。 「これからはもっと裁量を持って、自分のチームを動かしてみたい」 「後輩の育成に興味があるけれど、今の環境ではなかなかチャンスが回ってこない」 「会社が大きくなっていくダイナミズムを肌で感じてみたい」 そんな熱い想いや、現状へのもどかしさを抱えているなら、そのエネルギーをぜひアイティサーフで爆発させてください。 あなたの参画が、アイティサーフの新しい歴史の幕開けになります。 会社を、そしてあなた自身を次のステージへと引き上げる挑戦を、私たちと一緒に始めませんか? 私たちは、あなたの培ってきた経験と、これからへの情熱を全力で受け止める準備ができています。 あなたからの熱いご応募を、心よりお待ちしています!

jobs.description: ■ミッション■ このポジションのミッションは大きく2つあります。 1つ目は、価値の具体化を技術視点でリードすること。 プロダクトオーナーとタッグを組み、具体的な開発要件に落とし込む中でより最適な形にするために議論する。これにより、負荷を分散するだけでなく、より最適な価値が提供できる状態をつくることができる組織になると考えています。 2つ目は、プロダクト起点で事業をリードできる開発チームの一員になること。 今のWHEREのプロダクトは、事業の成長速度に品質が追いつかなくなってきている状態のため、今後の成長に耐えうる品質基盤へ整えている最中です。 今後は不動産の取引を変える視点で、プロダクト起点で実現したい構想が多数あり、それを実現することによって事業をリードできるプロダクト・開発チームへと強化していきます。 そのためのプロダクトづくり・体制づくりをぜひ一緒に担っていただきたいです。 ■業務詳細■ ・プロダクトのバックエンド/インフラ開発全般(機能開発、改善、運用) ・POとの詳細仕様の設計 ・スクラムチームのリード/一員としてのプロダクト開発・フロー改善 ・Python を用いたAPIサーバーの設計・開発・運用 ・AWS CDK によるインフラのコード化・運用 ・ECS Fargate上でのスケーリング設計・運用最適化 ・Snowflakeを含むデータ基盤の構築・運用 ・様々なデータを活用したWHEREの独自データの構築/AI構築 ・より汎用性を上げるプラットフォーム化 ・非機能要件(可用性、性能、コスト、運用性)に対する継続的改善 ※最初からすべてを担当する必要はありません ※インフラ・バックエンドを主軸としつつ、必要に応じてフロントエンドやGISなど横断的に関わっていただきます ■開発環境■ 開発環境 ・Frontend: Next.js (TypeScript) ・Backend: FastAPI (Python) ・Infra: AWS ・Database: PostgreSQL ・CI/CD: GitHub Actions ・Documents / Projects: Notion ・エンジニアには34インチワイドモニターを支給 ・Claude Code ライセンス配布

jobs.description: クリエイターとファンの関係を深めるプラットフォーム『FANME』を中心に、企画から設計・実装・改善までを一気通貫で担うプロダクトエンジニアを募集します。 FANMEはリンクまとめ・EC・デジタルコンテンツ・ファンクラブなどを通じてクリエイターの収益化を支えるサービスで、月間200万UUを超えるまでに成長しました。さらに多くのユーザーに愛されるプロダクトへスケールさせるフェーズです。TikTok Shop/TikTok Live向けのツール(動画の自動編集、Liveオーバーレイ表示、オーダー分析、Live分析 など)も、スピード感を持って次々と立ち上げています。 【具体的な業務】 ・PdM・デザイナー・ビジネスサイドと連携し、企画の実現方法・スコープ・仕様を整理 ・Next.jsによるフロントエンド、NestJS/tRPC/Prismaによるバックエンドの設計・実装 ・企画を小さく素早くリリースし、数値やユーザーの反応をもとに改善 【開発環境】 ・バックエンド:TypeScript/NestJS/tRPC/Prisma ・フロントエンド:Next.js/TypeScript/Tailwind CSS ・データベース:MySQL/PostgreSQL ・IaC・CI/CD:Terraform/GitHub Actions ・監視:Datadog/データ分析:BigQuery/Metabase/Google Analytics ・AI活用:1人あたり月10万円までの予算(企画・設計・実装・レビュー・テスト等に利用可) 【この仕事の面白さ】 ・熱量の高いクリエイター経済のど真ん中で、収益化に直結するプロダクトを作れる ・企画→実装→改善のサイクルを自分の手で高速に回せる裁量の大きさ ・モダンなTypeScriptスタックとAIツールをフル活用できる開発環境

jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: Japan Visa Sponsorship: Future possibility / Renewal 🍎 Native-Level English. 🍎 Bachelor's degree (when needed at immigration for the visa). 🍎 You must be in Japan now and ready to interview in Tokyo with permission to work (No tourist/temporary visa). 🍎 You own a Japanese cellphone number and a local bank / Japan Post account. Job Description New Opening Plaza in Chiba! 🍎 Are you passionate about making English learning the best part of a child's day? We are looking for enthusiastic instructors to join us in Tokyo and the surrounding areas. Why Choose BE studio? As part of Benesse Holdings - a leader in Japan’s education industry—we offer the support you need to thrive: 🍎 Stability & Growth: Reliable employment with a household name. 🍏 Full Support: Visa sponsorship and comprehensive benefits (more details below). 🍎 Meaningful Work: Be a vital part of a child’s developmental journey. Who We Are Looking For 🍏 Instructors who prioritise motivation and fun over memorisation. 🍎 Energetic individuals who love working with children. 🍏 Eager candidates currently in or moving to the Greater Tokyo Area. About BE studio BE studio values students' "BE YOURSELF" and "WANT TO BE". 100 Students. 100 Stories. At BE studio, we know no two students are the same. We don’t just teach English; we build the bridge to the rest of the world. Our Goal: Equip students to collaborate globally, communicate from the heart, and create real-world value. Different paths. One global future. 🍎 Longevity! We opened our first studio in 1975, decades of experience and proven success. 🍏 Diversity! Join a team of 400 teachers from 50 different countries. 🍎 Convenience! Work where life happens, our studios are right in department stores near major train stations. Advantages of BE studio The Setup: 🍏 Ready-to-Go: Lesson plans provided. Less prep, no stress. 🍎 Support System: Work alongside a Japanese partner in every plaza. 🍏 Small Classes: Maximum of 8 regular students per lesson. 🍎 Fun First: Game-focused learning that kids actually love. The Schedule: 🍎 Work-Life Balance: 35-hour work week. 🍏 True Breaks: "No Lesson Days" for training, prep, or vacation. 🍎 Reliability: Fixed yearly schedule with the same students (for regular teachers) 🍏 Time Off: National holidays usually off + 10 company holidays + 10 paid leave days. 🍎 Bonus Rest: "Happy Mondays" special paid leave available in some cases. The Perks: 🍏 Easy Entry: No Japanese language required. 🍎 Full Coverage: Transportation costs fully covered. 🍏 Health & Security: Social insurance (Shakai Hoken) + Benesse’s extra insurance scheme. 🍎 Growth: Dedicated mentors to support you individually and ongoing training. 🍏 Future-Proof: Visa sponsorship available in some cases and renewable contracts. Contract type: Full Time Compensation 🍎 Full Time from 264,000 to 275,000 yen / month (Saturday & Sunday plus 3 week days) 🍏 Work hours: lessons are generally between 10:00- 21:00 (different work shifts) Work schedule: Generally, 7 work hours / day Job Description 🍏 Work days: 5 🍎 Days off: 2 🍏 Work hours: 35 hours per week 🍎 Deliver 50, 60, 70 minute group lessons (maximum of 8 students / class) 🍏 Prepare for the lessons (review lesson plans, clean up materials, tidy up the room etc.) 🍎 Work with Japanese lesson partner to provide high quality lessons and customer service 🍏 Deliver special lessons and participate in seasonal events 🍎 All lesson plans are provided and the materials will be ready at each classrooms The Tools: You own a Japanese phone number and a local bank account. Decency: Tattoos / piercings must be covered The Skills: 🍎 Kid-Focused: Passionate about teaching students under 12. 🍏 Rapport Builder: Great with kids, great with parents. 🍎 Cultural: Ready to thrive in a Japanese workplace. Professional, sensitive, and polished. The Schedule & Commute: 🍎 Availability: Ready for Saturdays and/or Sundays, and shifts until 21:00. 🍏 On the Move: Commutes up to 60 minutes (Regular) or 90 minutes (Substitution). Experience: 🍎 Eikaiwa experience is a plus, but we’ll train the right person!

jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Fluent Required Japanese Level: Conversational Level Current Residence Requirement: Japan Visa Sponsorship: Future possibility / Renewal 1. Fluent English skills are required. Native speakers are preferred. Applicants who speak basic Japanese will be given preference, as understanding and speaking Japanese is vital to this role. You will be asked to speak Japanese in the interview. 2. This is a part-time position. However if we are a good fit for each other, full-time is available in the future. We do offer VISA sponsorship. 3. Please note in your message when you are available to work and how many days you would like. We will overlook those applicants that do not let us know their availability. * Tuesday : 2:00 -> 9:00 * Wednesday : 2:00 -> 9:00 * Thursday : 2:00 -> 9:00 * Friday : 2:00 -> 9:00 * Saturday : 9:00 -> 6:00 4. We are looking for someone who is: responsible, can lead children well, is an interesting person, takes ownership, and adds value to our small team. We always welcome new ideas and ways of teaching, and we are looking for someone who will be an active participant in making our school better :) Job Description Green Tree English (GTE) was founded in 2017 in Nishi-Tokyo and offers students a different way of learning English. We are a mix of an international school and an eikaiwa. We teach children from ages 0-12 and classes are small. GTE is known for its unique atmosphere, creative crafts, exciting experiments, fun lessons, teachers that care and effective teaching. Some classes are solo teaching and others are paired teaching. We are looking to add energetic, responsible and proactive individuals to our team. We are looking for someone that has the heart of a teacher; someone who is motivated by seeing children grow and learn from you, not just in English, but in all areas of development; someone who believes in the potential of children and will do their best to help their growth. Sundays and Mondays are off. It is located in Nishi-Tokyo (West Tokyo), a few minutes walk from Tanashi Station. -Responsibilities- As a teacher, your duties include: creating lesson plans, performing lessons (singing songs, dancing, teaching vocabulary, playing games, helping students make crafts, etc.), preparing crafts and experiments, taking pictures of classes and interacting with parents and students alike. Beyond that, there is also cleaning the school and advertising. We also hold in-class events such as Christmas, Halloween, etc. where you may be required to wear costumes, make decorations, etc. We do all our work on Canva, experience with Canva will be a benefit. -Benefits- -Working visa renewal -Training will be provided -Opportunity for promotion -If you have children, they are able to attend classes at the school for free -A real opportunity to grow your ability in Japanese -- our school does not have an in-class "no Japanese" rule that some other schools enforce -Non-corporate business atmosphere. A friendly and fun work environment -You get paid to have fun teaching kids. Seriously! We really love our students and do our best to create a place where they can be accepted, motivated, and have fun. If Green Tree English sounds like the place you want to be, please contact us! Thank you for your time in checking out this listing and we hope to hear from you soon!

jobs.title: International Baccalaureate (IB) Academic Instructor (Remote / In-person, Part-time)
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: None Visa Sponsorship: Yes Job Description We are always looking for outstanding individuals to join our tutoring and teaching team. All tutors have exceptional academic credentials and/or professional backgrounds, making Tokyo Academics one of the most inspiring educational organizations in Japan. Tokyo Academics is seeking experienced and passionate instructors with a strong background in International Baccalaureate (IB) coursework to support our growing base of IB students across a range of subjects. We welcome educators from around the world who are familiar with the rigor and unique structure of the IB curriculum and are excited to work with motivated international students. We have flexible hours to fit your schedule, whether you are a post-secondary student seeking meaningful part-time work to leverage your educational background or a working professional aiming to build a career in education/teaching. This role offers part-time, remote, or in-person work arrangements. *Relocation support and visa sponsorship available! Who you are: Inspirational - You represent top universities and the requisite academic rigors for entry. You inspire and establish credibility with high school students and their parents. Nurturing - You are committed to instilling essential academic skills to future generations, so they, too, can reach their maximum potential. Test Prep Oriented - You have the mindset to “game the system” and maximize scores: our students aim to earn high scores on the IB, SAT, ACT, AP, ISEE and SSAT to apply to competitive middle schools, high schools, and universities. Disciplined - You know when to apply a soft touch or discipline as needed. Our group classes require teachers to sometimes manage disengaged or disruptive students. Academically Excellent - You have a superior record of performance academically and on standardized examinations (IB, SAT, ACT, AP, A-Levels, etc.). You have subject matter expertise across multiple subjects: math, sciences, English, etc. OR you have a deep level of expertise in one subject that spans multiple grade levels: all levels of math, all levels of sciences, etc. Professional - You respond in a timely manner to important communication on various platforms (email, phone call, messenger, etc.). You communicate appropriately for internal and external needs. You can adjust to organizational structures, lines of reporting, and the right forums to address issues. Passionate - You have a passion for teaching students and helping them achieve academic goals. You go above and beyond to help and mentor students to reach new educational frontiers. You may have previous teaching, tutoring, coaching, or leadership experience. Team Minded - You are a quick study, a strong and rapid communicator, and an energetic and collaborative team member. You have the ability to self-manage your priorities and calendar. Committed - You are dedicated to seeing a student through to the end. Be it to the target scores, the final exam at the end of the year, or the college admissions, you will put in the time to reach success. What you will be doing: (based on your background/capability and client needs) 1. Teaching and mentoring students both one-on-one and in classes. Core Subjects include: Reading comprehension (elementary to AP/IB or equivalent) Writing (elementary to AP/IB or equivalent) Math (elementary to calculus) History (World, US, & European) Chemistry (AP/IB or equivalent) Physics (AP/IB or equivalent) Biology (AP/IB or equivalent) Standardized Test Prep (SAT/ACT, SSAT/ISEE, etc.) Our students range from elementary, middle, and high school. Most of our IB students are in the IB Diploma Programme, but we also work with students in the MYP and PYP stages. We do our best to match you with students in your preferred subject areas (please indicate in your application). 2. Following an adaptively rigorous approach to learning with the flipped classroom method as inspiration. 3. Managing the cases of your students: scheduling, goal tracking, parent communication, escalation on needs and concerns, etc. 4. Working towards opportunities for greater responsibility and commensurate compensation. Career Prospects: Explore entrepreneurial opportunities beyond the classroom Navigate diverse career paths including academics tutoring, college admissions consulting, curriculum development, research mentorship, tech education, and more Career development and increased compensation for longer tenures Benefits: Best international tutoring compensation in Tokyo Flexible work hours that accommodate your schedule and lifestyle Access to teaching materials and comprehensive training Comprehensive relocation assistance including a relocation stipend and providing visa sponsorship, to ensure a seamless transition to Japan/Tokyo Scholarship opportunities Be part of our diverse and elite academic community Work hours: Work hours will align with the schedules of students in Tokyo, Japan. Typical hours of operation are from 4 PM to 10 PM Japan Standard Time on weekdays, and 9 AM to 9 PM Japan Standard Time on weekends.

jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description Our facility includes an English-language preschool for children aged 0 to 6 and an English-after-school program for elementary school students. Teaching qualifications are not required, but past experience is more than welcome. You will also be in charge of science and geography activity sessions when you're ready; however, the content is simple, and we provide training, so there is no need to worry even if it is your first time. A certain training period is provided, so even those concerned about your lack of experience can get started with confidence and you'll get raised after the training period. We also have English conversation classes, so if you wish, you can take charge of those lessons. We have instructors for extracurricular classes such as karate, calligraphy, piano, gymnastics, abacus allowing students to pursue their interests before heading home; we also have a Chinese language teacher, so students can learn Chinese in addition to English. There are plenty of fun events, such as trips to an amusement park and strawberry picking for the spring excursion, and a visit to a safari park for the autumn excursion and so on. Why not join us and work in a cheerful, international environment? Your working schedule will be 8:00-17:00 or 10:00-19:00 or 10:30-19:30. Your weekly days off are Saturday and Sunday (+national holidays).

jobs.company: New World International School (ニューワールド インターナショナルスクール)
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Native-level English proficiency Bachelor's degree or higher Minimum 5 years of Preschool or Kindergarten teaching experience Teaching license or Early Childhood Education qualification preferred Strong classroom management and teamwork skills Description Job Description Kindergarten Homeroom Teacher (Full-time) New World International School is a well-established international preschool in Chofu, Tokyo, with over 20 years of experience providing a warm, English-speaking environment where children are loved, accepted, and encouraged to grow. We are seeking an experienced and passionate Kindergarten Homeroom Teacher to join our team. This position is ideal for a teacher who enjoys creating meaningful learning experiences, building strong relationships with children and families, and working collaboratively with colleagues. You will be responsible for a class of approximately ten children aged 4–5 years old. Your role will include planning and leading engaging lessons, supporting children's social, emotional, and academic development, observing and assessing children's progress, communicating with parents, and preparing classroom materials. Our curriculum is built around STEAM education, hands-on learning, a theme-based approach, nature walks, cooking, gardening, arts and crafts, and literacy development. We encourage curiosity, creativity, kindness, and independence through play-based learning. As a member of our team, you will also participate in school events and work closely with other teachers to maintain a positive, organized, and welcoming learning environment. At our school, all staff work together to prepare classrooms, organize materials, and help keep the school clean and comfortable for everyone. Working Conditions Full-time position Typical working hours: 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. One-hour lunch break Five-day work week Start date: To be discussed Benefits Starting salary from ¥300,000/month (negotiable depending on experience) Social insurance Employment insurance Paid annual leave Annual health checkup Transportation allowance Professional development opportunities Requirements Native-level English proficiency Bachelor's degree or higher Minimum 5 years of Preschool or Kindergarten teaching experience Strong classroom management and teamwork skills Teaching license or Early Childhood Education qualification preferred Applicants must currently reside in Japan If you are an enthusiastic educator who enjoys working in a supportive team and believes in providing meaningful learning experiences for young children, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Part time EFL Junior High School Teacher in Takao, Tokyo from the last week of August
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan We only accept current holders of visas allowing work in Japan. Who can work Tuesdays and Thursdays, starting from the last week of August 2026. Description Part time EFL Junior High School Teacher in Hachioji, Tokyo from at the last week of August 2026 This is a part-time position on Tuesdays and Thursdays only, starting in the last week of August 2026. Please apply only if you are looking for a part-time position. Thank you for your interest in working for Project Genius, a concern of Korakuen English Centre. We aim to be the premier English language consultancy firm for private secondary schools in Japan. Our client school for this position is a prestigious private school near Takao Station on the Keio Line and JR Chuo Line. We are looking for a professional who can work well within a small team and is able to be a team player and compromise while keeping a positive attitude with the staff and teachers, Japanese and non-Japanese, at our client school. Two teachers from our company at this client-school share one homeroom and lesson plans during each lesson. Our teachers are responsible for all aspects of the class, from lesson planning to classroom management and grading. We are looking for someone who can work two days a week, Tuesdays and Thursdays. This position starts from the last week of August 2026. We will only consider candidates who already live and are able to work in Japan. Our compensation package includes ● A monthly pre-tax salary of 120,000 yen per month. ● Transportation expenses will be fully covered and reimbursed. ● A Japanese school year based renewable contract. ● Remuneration is the same every month, regardless of time off during summer, winter, spring, and other holidays during the school year. Please tell us in your cover letter why you are a good fit to join our team. Our ideal candidate is someone who: ● hold a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution. ● can reach the school within one hour from their home or willing to commute for a long distance. ● has at least one year experience teaching at a public or private secondary school in Japan. ● is comfortable solo teaching, managing and evaluating classes of up to 20 students. ● is interested in teaching active, communicative lessons. ● is able and willing to teach with other teachers and can effectively collaborate with teachers both in and outside the classroom. ● is able and willing to develop and share ideas for lesson plans, activities, and materials. ● enjoys talking about teaching and pedagogy and is able to be self reflective about their teaching and willing to share their thoughts before and after a lesson. ● is able to be a team player and compromise while keeping a positive attitude with the staff and teachers, Japanese and non-Japanese, at our client school as well as with our off-site office and executive team. ● is willing to communicate with and take advice from our management team both on-line and in-person to ensure effective results for our client-schools and their students. ● speaks English at a native-level proficiency. ● speaks conversational-level Japanese, if possible. ● current holders of visas allowing work in Japan. We will give special consideration to candidates who: ● have a TESOL-certificate from an accredited institution. Candidates whose resumes and cover letters show that they meet these requirements and who we feel will be a good match for the school will be contacted for an interview. Due to the number of resumes we receive we are unable to contact all applicants, but we do keep resumes on file and if you do not hear from us for this position, we may contact you in the future if a more suitable position becomes available.

We publish the English restaurant guidebook "WINING & DINING in TOKYO + KANSAI", run an English restaurant search website "JapanRestaurant.net" and an English and Japanese web magazine "Jselect.net." We also publish a digital magazine and provide restaurant information and useful living information on SNS such as Facebook, Instagram and X. Due to increasing of oversea tourists, business expansion and new sales team establishment, we are looking for media advertising sales representatives. Account Executive / advertising sales representative for English magazine and website. Working conditions: Full-time: 5 days a week or Part-time: 3 days a week (choose from Monday to Friday); work time (10:00 a.m. ~ 6:00 p.m.); monthly basic allowance plus commission. (*full timer is required 1 year or more B2B sales experience) Training provided. Potential for rapid promotion. After several month experiences, there is a chance to be promoted to Full-timer (for part-timer) / Sales Manager position depending on your sales performance. Visa sponsorship is available, after promotion to full-time. To give advertising proposals to restaurants and companies that are targeting both foreign residents in Japan and foreign visitors. We aim to support their marketing and promotion activities. - Market research to find potential clients - Calling or email potential clients for setting up business appointments - Make presentations, proposals, negotiate contracts (online and face-to-face) - Process management for advertising artwork - Client management - Customer service - Good communication and negotiation skills - Self-motivated and goal oriented - Confident and capable of cold-calling - Standard PC skills for Word and Excel - Native English Speakers, Europeans or Japanese - Conversational or Business level Japanese ability - Must currently reside in Japan - Live within the Greater Tokyo Area (no requirement for freelancer) - Long-term Worker (at least one year) - Sales experience and Japanese ability preferred. - Company iPad and computer provided - Free tea, coffee and snacks in the office - Fun events for employees (BBQ, Year-End party, etc) - Long company holidays: Golden Week, Summer: 11 days, Winter: 15 days (2026) Monthly Payment Part-time and Full-time: commission plus monthly basic allowance. Transportation expense, monthly sales performance bonus. Estimated monthly income: Full-timer: five days a week, excludes transportation expense. ¥280,000 / month (in case of ¥1million monthly sales) ¥400,000 / month (in case of ¥2million monthly sales) ¥520,000 / month (in case of ¥3million monthly sales) Part-timer: three days a week, excludes transportation expense. ¥230,000 / month (in case of ¥1million monthly sales) ¥350,000 / month (in case of ¥2million monthly sales) ¥470,000 / month (in case of ¥3million monthly sales) We seek active and social people. Part-timer is good for person who want to work in international atmosphere and women whose children have grown up and who want to return to professional work as a part-timer. jobs.description: This is a standalone senior engineering position responsible for the reliability, security, and ongoing development of the company’s infrastructure across its Japanese locations. The role is approximately divided between: 50% network and systems design, configuration, and implementation 50% infrastructure maintenance, operations, and troubleshooting The strongest focus is on enterprise networking and high-density Wi-Fi infrastructure. The engineer will support environments containing hundreds of wireless access points, together with switches, network-security platforms, monitoring tools, access-control systems, and related business infrastructure. The Systems & Network Engineer will operate independently in Japan while reporting in English to a overseas-based hiring manager and collaborating with the wider global technology organization. Because the engineer may need to communicate directly with Japanese tenants, vendors, and local stakeholders during technical incidents and infrastructure projects, advanced Japanese communication skills are essential. Responsibilities include: - Designing, configuring, and implementing network and systems infrastructure - Managing high-density Wi-Fi environments across multiple sites - Monitoring performance, capacity, availability, and security - Troubleshooting complex network and infrastructure incidents - Supporting physical access-control systems - Managing infrastructure changes and technical documentation - Coordinating with global IT teams and external vendors - Managing incidents and requests through Jira - Participating in emergency support when critical systems fail outside standard business hours The engineer will oversee infrastructure across Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka. Domestic business travel is expected approximately once every one or two months, as well as when required for projects or urgent technical issues. The position is well suited to a senior individual contributor who can independently assess an environment, identify technical risks, and take ownership of infrastructure from design through ongoing operation. CCIE-level knowledge would be highly valued, although certification is not mandatory. ITIL knowledge is also advantageous. Cloud experience is welcomed but is significantly less important than strong hands-on networking, Wi-Fi, troubleshooting, and infrastructure implementation experience.

jobs.title: Inbound Tourism Staff / Live in Koyasan with Free Accommodation!
jobs.description: Requirements English: Conversational Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description Full-time|Company housing provided|Grow your Japanese every day ! 【About the role】 On the sacred mountain of Koyasan — a UNESCO World Heritage site — we run the Okunoin Night Tour® and our attached Café Bar TAIRA. Around 60% of our guests come from overseas, and your core role is to connect them with Japanese culture: guiding international visitors in English, explaining the meaning behind what they're seeing, tasting and experiencing, and coordinating with our team. You'll guide guests in English, while our team works in Japanese — so your Japanese keeps growing every day. 【What you'll do】 Your main work is cross-cultural communication and interpretation: ・Guiding and briefing international guests in English at our tour reception — sharing the Okunoin Night Tour®, the history and meaning of Koyasan and Shingon Buddhism, and answering their questions ・Introducing Wakayama's local food and drink culture to overseas guests — explaining the story, origin and character of each regional specialty as you serve it, so guests understand what they're tasting, not just receive it ・Working as the bridge between international guests and our Japanese tour guides and team (relaying needs, coordinating schedules, resolving questions) ・Presenting our original products, crafts and vintage items to a global audience in the shop As part of a small team, everyone also shares in the hands-on running of the shop — preparing and serving the drinks and simple dishes you'll be introducing (including cocktails and grilled rice balls), washing up, keeping the space clean, light PC work for reservations, point-of-sale, and opening and closing preparation. This is a small team, so these supporting tasks come with the territory, alongside a role centered on international guest communication. 【Starting out】 ・We have clear, thorough manuals, so you can begin with confidence even if this kind of work is new to you. ・You'll grow fast here — working alongside an experienced bilingual colleague and a Japanese team, in an environment where your Japanese naturally sharpens every day. ・Before you join, we arrange a visit to Koyasan so you can see the actual work and daily life here before deciding. 【Why this place is different】 ・Work somewhere the world pays attention to. Our tours — and our founder personally — have been featured by major international media, including the BBC, the New York Times, Vogue and NHK WORLD. ・Quality over volume. Rather than processing large tour groups, we take time with each culturally curious traveler — hospitality you can be proud of. ・Your ideas take shape. In a small team, suggestions land easily; menu items proposed by staff have gone on to become signatures. 【Growth & career path】 You'll start as the face of the shop, mastering guest communication and reception. From there, depending on your interests and aptitude, you can step up to leader or store manager. There's also a path to becoming a licensed tour guide, with company support toward national qualifications such as the Licensed Guide Interpreter (通訳案内士). Beyond that — menu development, SNS marketing, regional tourism — there's room to build a long career while widening your skills. 【What we're looking for】 Requirements ・Business-level Japanese (JLPT N2 or equivalent) — used daily with guests and colleagues ・Strong conversational English, used to guide, explain and interpret for international guests ・A genuine interest in sharing Japanese culture, history and food with people from abroad ・A valid status of residence that permits full-time work in this role in Japan ・Someone who can enjoy life in a quiet mountain setting Nice to have ・Experience in tourism, hospitality, interpretation/translation, or guiding ・Experience from study abroad or living between cultures that you'd like to put to use ・A strong interest in travel, Japanese culture or inbound tourism You'll fit well if you ・Enjoy giving each guest your genuine attention ・Like sharing your ideas within a small team ・Feel recharged, surrounded by nature 【Compensation】 ・Base salary: from ¥220,000/month — but this is just the starting point. We set your pay from day one based on your experience, skills and qualifications, so if you bring relevant background, let's talk. ・Company-covered housing: a private company apartment (one unit per person), with rent and common fees fully covered by the company — worth around ¥50,000/month, bringing the real value of your package to at least ¥270,000/month equivalent from the start ・Low countryside living costs mean your take-home goes much further here than the same salary in a big city Real example from our current team (JLPT N2): A team member with N2-level Japanese earns the equivalent of about ¥3.8M per year — roughly ¥3.3M in salary plus about ¥516,000/year in fully company-covered housing. Your package grows with your experience, skills and the value you bring. 【Other conditions】 ・Employment: Full-time (probation period applies) ・Hours: 12:35–22:00 (8 hours actual work, 85 min break); little to no overtime, no late-night shifts ・Holidays: 123 days/year, shift-based; longer consecutive breaks are easy to take in the quiet winter season (Dec–Feb) 【How to apply】 When you apply, please include in your message: - A line on why you'd like to work in Koyasan - Your current status of residence (visa type) and its expiry date We're looking for someone who can commit for the long term (at least one year), so please make sure your residence status allows for that. Due to the large number of applications we receive, we regret that we are only able to respond to candidates who are shortlisted. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Online French teacher - Professeurs de français, travail à domicile au monde
jobs.description: Requirements French: Fluent Visa sponsorship available Description 【 Recherche professeurs de français, travail à domicile via Zoom (quel que soit le pays où vous habitez) 】 Notre entreprise « Ensemble en Français » est une école de français en ligne utilisant Zoom pour dispenser des cours en ligne aux apprenants japonais vivant dans le monde entier. Depuis l'ouverture de l'école en février 2010, le nombre d'élèves a continué d'augmenter chaque année, ce qui a entraîné un recrutement permanent de professeurs de français (Japonais ou natifs de langue française). Vous pouvez obtenir un revenu régulier en proposant des cours de français via Zoom à l’heure de votre choix et depuis votre domicile. ------------------------------------------------------- 1. Récapitulatif : ・ Cours particuliers de français sur Zoom. ・ Enseigner principalement à des adultes (vous pouvez aussi enseigner aux enfants si vous le souhaitez). ・ Vous pouvez dispenser vos cours depuis votre domicile à n’importe quelle heure de la journée, 24h sur 24. ・ Votre emploi du temps n’a pas besoin d’être fixe, vous pouvez le changer à votre guise selon vos disponibilités (à condition que vous puissiez fournir au moins 10 leçons (50 minutes x 10) par semaine). ・ Avant votre début officiel en tant qu'instructeur, vous devrez passer un stage rémunéré (1000 yens pour 50 minutes de cours). La durée de la formation varie en fonction de l'expérience de l'instructeur. En règle générale, le temps de formation requis pour les enseignants expérimentés est de 6 à 20 heures. ・ Au cours de la formation, nous vous renseignerons de manière simple et compréhensible des méthodes d’enseignement sur Zoom ayant fait leurs preuves au sein de notre école, et des astuces afin de dispenser des cours de haut niveau en tant que professeurs de français. ・ En plus des cours sur Zoom, les personnes ayant un niveau professionnel de japonais et pouvant participer au travail de bureau de l’école et aux relations publiques, pourront obtenir une rémunération supplémentaire. ・ Pour ceux qui ont un visa étudiant et remplissent certaines conditions telles que le nombre de leçons et le degré de contribution à l'école, un visa de travail peut être sponsorisé par l’école. ------------------------------------------------------ 2. Rémunération : 1,500〜2,200 JPY / un cours de 50mn. 50,000〜450,000 JPY / mois selon le nombre de cours ------------------------------------------------------ 3. Compétences et personnalité requises par notre école : ・ Avoir au moins 3 mois d’expérience dans l’enseignement du français (vous pouvez être dispensé de cette condition si vous avez de l'expérience en tant que professeur d'anglais ou autre) ・ Aimer enseigner le français, être très motivé et avoir le sens des responsabilités. ------------------------------------------------------ 4. Les avantages à travailler au sein de notre école : ・ Vous pouvez travailler à domicile quel que soit le pays où vous habitez, il n'y a donc aucune perte de temps. ・ La possibilité d’obtenir un revenu stable et élevé en augmentant le nombre d'étudiants réguliers. ・ De nombreux instructeurs ont gagné un revenu élevé après leur début officiel, en fonction de leurs efforts et de leur croissance au cours de la formation, bien qu'ils n'avaient que peu d’expérience en tant que professeur jusque-là. ・ Ce travail vous apporte non seulement l’opportunité de travailler en parallèle de votre occupation principale mais aussi d’en faire votre principal emploi, la plupart des instructeurs travaillent depuis longtemps dans notre l’école. Nous sommes fiers de la longueur de leur carrière chez nous. ・ Nous veillons à ce que le personnel administratif soutienne l'instructeur avec soin, afin de maintenir un niveau élevé de leçons et d’assurer un nombre stable d'élèves. ------------------------------------------------------ 5. Le profil recherché est le suivant : ・ Posséder un compte bancaire japonais ・ (Si vous habitez à l’étranger) posséder un compte bancaire pouvant recevoir un virement via Wise dont la commission est à votre charge ・ (Si vous habitez à l'étranger) être auto/micro-entrepreneur ou en free-lance ・ Posséder un numéro de SIRET ou de statut d'équivalent (L'obtention de numéro de SIRET après la formation sera acceptée) ・ Pouvoir donner plus de 10 leçons (50 minutes x 10) par semaine ・ Avoir l'habitude d'utiliser Zoom et posséder une bonne connexion internet filière à la maison. (L'utilisation de la connexion WIFI durant les cours est interdite.) ・ Avoir un PC ou un Mac qui fonctionne convenablement ・ Être capable de taper rapidement le français avec les accents ------------------------------------------------------ 6. Notes concernant la postulation à ce travail : ・ Veuillez nous envoyer par mail les trois fichiers suivants : - CV à jour en français (ou japonais pour candidat japonais) - Lettre de motivation en français - Courte vidéo de votre présentation en français d'environ une minute en tant que futur professeur d'Ensemble en Français adressée aux élèves (MP4 ou MOV). Veuillez nous l'envoyer via un site de transfert de fichier comme GigaFile. ・ Assurez-vous d’y inclure votre expérience en tant qu’instructeur. ・ Veuillez nous indiquer vos disponibilités pour les leçons et le nombre de leçons par semaine que vous souhaitez faire Exemple : « En semaine de 16h à 21h, 20 leçons par semaine ».
