jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Basic Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description 🗻 Creative & Enthusiastic English Teachers Needed For Our Kids! 🗻 Since we take care of small children, people who love working with kids and have experience are especially welcome! 👨‍🏫👩‍🏫 Our teachers form a tight-knit team and have a group of bilingual Japanese staff who are always there to offer support and assistance. We work together to let our kids have fun, learn English, and build confidence in their language skills! 🏫 Since our teachers go to different kindergartens, they are very independent but collaborate and work together as a team often. ✨ We encourage our teachers to try new approaches, with all teachers having the freedom to plan their own lessons and tailor them to their students’ needs while being guided by our overall curriculum. As well as helping our students work, we strive to create an environment where our teachers can grow too. We hold regular training and always have mentors available for advice. Teachers take care of their own regular classes and students. We also have seasonal events, trips, and a lot of fun! 🙌Additionally we offer a leadership route for advancement for teachers who show potential and want to build their careers. <What we're looking for in a teacher!> ✅ Must love working with kids! ✅ Native-level English speaker ✅ Energetic and enthusiastic ✅ Good understanding of cultural differences ✅ Valid working visa ✅ Commitment to stay in the position for at least one year or longer ✅ Available for an in-person interview in Japan <Job Openings> ⭐ 【Kindergarten teacher】 *Location: - The main office is located in Shinyurigaoka, Kanagawa (20 mins from Shinjuku, Tokyo) Our contracted kindergartens are located around Kanagawa and Tokyo. 🗓️ Start period: - Fall 2026 📕 Class Types: - Morning: bigger classes (25~35 students, 10-30 min classes) - Afternoon: smaller classes (3~10 students, 50-60 min classes) 💼 Work conditions: - Mon-Fri (Saturday & Sunday off) - 8 hours/day (ex: 9am-5pm, 10am-6pm) - Salary is fixed and paid monthly - Health insurance is provided 💰 Contract completion bonus (dependent on work evaluation) 📅 Time Off: Two days a week, Golden Week, National Holidays, Summer Vacation, Winter Vacation, and 10 paid vacation days initially 🏯 We encourage teachers to have a better understanding of Japanese language and culture by subsidizing partial tuition fees for Japanese language school 💮 An additional monthly allowance is given to all teachers who have passed JLPT N3, N2 or N1! <How To Apply> Please submit a resume and a cover letter. Your resume should include any relevant paid or voluntary experience highlighting your teaching credentials. We love to hear about your achievements in a teaching role. Also please make sure you include the following: 1.Photo 2.Date of Birth 3.Nationality 4.Place of residence 5.Current visa status Please note only candidates who pass the initial screening process will be contacted. Unfortunately we are not able to respond to all applicants.

jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Description Full-time English Conversation Teacher at one of AEON’s 250+ branch schools all throughout Japan. AEON schools provide lessons for both children and adult students. We are accepting applications for positions starting from now through January, 2027. jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: Business level Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description We are seeking an Application Engineer who can design, develop, and maintain web applications that enhance the tax-free shopping experience for customers around the world. The role will primarily focus on developing the company's in-house tax-free sales application. You will be involved throughout the entire product lifecycle—from system design and development to deployment and ongoing improvements—and play a key role in driving product growth through technology. You will work closely with other engineers to design scalable systems and develop solutions that support multilingual users and the company's global expansion. Responsibilities Include: - Designing, developing, and maintaining web applications for tax-free sales - Developing applications using FastAPI (Python), React, and React Native - Designing APIs, integrating external services, and optimizing PostgreSQL databases - Improving existing features and planning and developing new functionality - Designing systems with multilingual support and global scalability in mind Required Qualifications: - 2+ years of experience in web application development - Experience developing applications using Python (FastAPI) - Experience with the React and React Native - Experience designing and managing databases using PostgreSQL - Experience collaborating on team based development using GitHub Preferred Qualifications: - Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs - Experience integrating third-party services or payment systems - Experience building multilingual or international web applications - Experience working on in-house products throughout the full development lifecycle We welcome candidates who are proactive, eager to learn, and take ownership of their work. This position offers the opportunity to build an in-house product from design through operation in a global environment where both English and Japanese communication skills are valuable. GPlusMedia Inc. will handle the document screening and initial interviews for the applicants on behalf of the company. Please note that you may be receiving contact from GPlusMedia when passing the initial screening. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate your interest and thank you for your understanding.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: Basic Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description Who We Are: The Worldfolio is a media and communication agency, as well as an international news platform, specializing in the production of socio-economic and industrial reports. Through our strategic partnerships with globally recognized media outlets, we develop high-impact multimedia campaigns that showcase the most dynamic sectors of Asian economies. Our work involves interviewing top executives from Fortune 500 companies, leading mid-sized enterprises, government officials, and industry experts. Our business model combines journalism, multimedia planning, and strategic advertising sales. Your Role: Business Development Associate – Japan Project As a Business Development Specialist for our Japan Project, you will play a key role in expanding the reach and impact of our editorial project. Your main responsibilities will include: - Securing interview opportunities through proactive cold calling and emailing. - Attending industry exhibitions to network with potential clients and interviewees. - Delivering presentations—both in person and online—to PR and communication departments of targeted companies. - Following up with clients and coordinating the publication process in collaboration with our editorial and design teams. - Conducting market research on relevant sectors and companies to support high-quality interviews and strategic insights. - Building comprehensive market profiles, including databases of companies and executives for future reports. What We're Looking For: We're looking for ambitious, driven individuals who enjoy connecting with people and are excited by the opportunity to make an impact. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced, international environment, we'd love to hear from you. You'd be a great fit if you are: - Confident and outgoing, with strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. - Comfortable speaking on the phone and able to build rapport and influence conversations naturally. - Curious and eager to learn, with an interest in global business, industry, economics, and current affairs. - Results-driven, motivated by achieving goals and earning performance-based rewards. - Resilient and focused, able to stay energetic and productive in a high-volume outreach environment. - Ambitious, with a desire to continuously develop your skills and grow into greater responsibilities. jobs.title: Full-time Native English Teacher at a Japanese Nursery in Tokyo
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Conversational Must currently reside in Japan Visa sponsorship available Description Clantete Mita is a Montessori nursery school that opened in 2013. We are a member of the Gakken Group, one of Japan's leading educational publishing and learning materials companies. We have English lessons as part of our daily curriculum and English activities such as science, simplified programming, and games a few times a week in the afternoons. We are looking for a bright, energetic native-level English speaker to join our team as soon as possible. Your role includes teaching English to children ages 1 to 2 (toddlers) or 3 to 5 (preschoolers), as well as supporting Japanese nursery staff with childcare duties. The younger children may require more personal care, such as assisting with handwashing or changing clothes. The ideal candidate is friendly, cheerful, and enthusiastic, loves working with young children, and enjoys making learning fun. You'll work alongside supportive Japanese staff in a friendly and collaborative environment, and on-the-job training will be provided to help you settle into your role. Applicants must speak native-level English and be eligible to work in Japan. ◆Working Hours Shifts are scheduled between 8 am and 7 pm. Actual working hours are 8 hours a day (including 1 hour break), Monday to Friday. Saturday meeting/training once a month with compensatory day off (daikyu). ◆Holidays Saturdays (or corresponding daikyu), Sundays, and public holidays. 10 days of paid leave (after 6 months). 5 days of summer leave, winter holiday. ◆Requirements ・Love working with young children ・Enjoy singing, dancing, and playing with children every day. ・Speak native-level English ・Speak conversation-level Japanese to communicate with Japanese staff ◆Qualifications/ Skills: (these are preferable but not required) ・Teaching license for nursery school, kindergarten, elementary school, or any child care license. ・Experience working at pre-school, after-school or English conversation school ◆Salary / Benefits Full-time position from as soon as possible. ・Monthly Salary: ¥240,000 to ¥288,000 (Negotiable depending on experience) ・Transportation allowance ・Visa sponsorship available ・Social insurance including health, pension, and employment insurance. ・Summer and winter bonuses *Visa sponsorship is available for eligible candidates currently residing in Japan. We will provide the necessary employer documentation to support visa extensions and changes of visa status. Please note that applicants are responsible for submitting their visa application and paying any associated fees. ◆Job Location Minato-ku, Tokyo 3-minute walk from Akabanebashi Station (Toei Oedo Line). Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: College Admissions Consultant - Art Portfolio Specialist (In-person, Part-time)
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Fluent Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: None Visa Sponsorship: Yes Job Description About Us: Tokyo Academics is the passion project of a constellation of teachers, researchers, and academics from around the world. Since 2012, we’ve evolved from a few university friends to a growing number of part-time and full-time individuals located in Tokyo, as well as working remotely. We are an organization of experts deeply passionate about helping students meet their potential and capture the opportunities of the future. We are looking for a professional College Admissions Consultant who specializes in art to help students prepare their art portfolios and navigate the admissions process for art schools and programs. A strong emphasis is placed on architecture; candidates with the ability to guide students through architecture-specific portfolio requirements and the distinct admissions landscape of top architecture programs are strongly preferred. We have flexible hours to fit your schedule. Part-time, remote, and/or in-person work arrangements are available. This is an exciting opportunity to join an organization of 150+ team members around the world. You will play a significant role in helping students build their future by identifying their strengths and leveraging them to create new opportunities. What you will work on: Your primary responsibility as a College Admissions Consultant will be to work with students in a 1-on-1 format to help them make decisions around their current high school trajectory and future college options. You will be providing guidance and advice on a wide range of topics, including (but not limited to): High School Course Selection Extracurricular Activities/Independent Projects Building a College List Identifying potential passions/majors/career interest Admission essay guidance Art portfolio requirements Artist statements Architecture portfolio development Preparing for interviews Provide internship support by advising students on identifying, applying for, and making the most of internship opportunities at architecture firms, design studios, and creative organizations to strengthen their applications and build real-world experience Given the wide range of student/family situations that potentially arise, successful hires will undergo in-depth training to gain a better understanding of Japan’s high schools, as well as Tokyo Academics’ college counseling process. Our ideal candidate: Possesses professional experience as an artist with a compelling portfolio, ideally complemented by a strong background in architecture Is proficient in multiple mediums/fields as an artist such as architecture, film, music and sound production, visual arts, photography, digital media, painting, sculpture, interior design, dance, and animation Lives and works in the Tokyo area Preferably has at least 2 years of college/admissions counseling experience, with demonstrated success in helping students receive offers to top schools Has graduated from a top tier U.S. or U.K. University Is very interested in working and living in Japan Has a track record of achievement in school academics and standardized testing Is passionate about mentorship, about engaging with students beyond their academics and playing a critical role in their success and character growth Has strong communication and collaboration skills, and can thrive in a start-up environment Is agile and able to respond to new information quickly and decisively Career Prospects: Explore entrepreneurial opportunities beyond the classroom Navigate diverse career paths including academics tutoring, essay counseling, curriculum development, research mentorship, tech education, and more Career development and increased compensation for longer tenures Benefits: Highly competitive rates in the market Flexible work hours that accommodate your schedule and lifestyle Access to teaching materials and comprehensive training Comprehensive relocation assistance including a relocation stipend and providing visa sponsorship, to ensure a seamless transition to Japan/Tokyo Scholarship opportunities Be part of our diverse and elite academic community Work hours: 5 to 20 hours per week, flexible schedule Work hours will align with the schedules of students in Tokyo, Japan. Peak hours of consulting range from 4pm to 10pm JST on weekdays, and 9am to 9pm JST on weekends

Benefits Competitive hourly pay based on qualifications and experience

jobs.title: Dispatch English teacher (Kanto-based) – visa support available & travel opportunities
jobs.description: Requirements English: Business level Japanese: None Proficiency in English at a native level Must possess an unrestricted working visa Visa sponsorship available Description Are you an adventurous educator looking to experience the diverse cultures of Japan? YARUKI Switch Career is seeking enthusiastic, resourceful individuals for our Dispatch Teacher roles. While traditional instructors stay at a single school, our Dispatch Teachers go where they’re needed most – stepping in to cover classes and ensure a smooth student experience at YARUKI Switch Group schools across Japan (such as Kids Duo, i Kids Star, or WinBe). In many cases, you will work at a location for a month or two at a time, providing an essential service to a school and its students. You will be based in the Kanto region but must be ready to take on assignments across the country, including in Chubu, Kansai, and Tohoku. If you love to travel, thrive on problem-solving, and want to experience local Japanese cultures firsthand, this is the perfect role for you! ◆ What’s in It for You? ・¥247,590/month (¥235,800 base salary + ¥11,790 operational allowance) ・Raise opportunities based on performance ・Ten paid days of leave per year (after six months of employment), in addition to national holidays ・¥100,000 contract-renewal bonus upon successful completion of the contract ・Fully paid initial training, including accommodation and transportation reimbursement ・Work-related commuting costs fully reimbursed; accommodations provided for long-distance dispatch work (all within company policy) ・Social Security and Health Insurance provided ・Visa sponsorship and renewal support available ・Support with securing housing, opening bank accounts, and more ◆ About the Role Dispatch Teachers will initially receive comprehensive training for the WinBe brand. Based on future needs, you may also be trained to support other educational brands, including i Kids Star and Kids Duo. A standard Dispatch Teacher shift is 7 hours and 15 minutes (not including a 45-minute break). When working for brands with longer shifts, overtime will be paid. YARUKI Switch Career Dispatch Teachers provide coverage at both directly managed and franchise schools. Directly managed schools are owned and operated by YARUKI Switch Group. Franchise locations are owned and run by independent owners who have an agreement with YARUKI Switch Group. Some job details may vary from location to location. WinBe (English conversation school) • Age group: 3 to 12 years old • Class size: Up to 6 students • Working shift: 7 hours and 15 minutes of work with a 45-minute break (total commitment of 8 hours). Tuesday to Friday shifts are from 12:00 to 20:00, 12:30 to 20:30, or 13:00 to 21:00, and Saturday shifts are 10:00 to 18:00. Kids Duo (After-school program) • Age group: 3 to 12 years old • Class size: 30+ students • Working shift: 8 hours of work with a 1-hour break (a total commitment of 9 hours). Shifts generally occur between 9:00 to 20:00 from Monday to Friday. A typical shift is from 11:00 to 20:00. i Kids Star (Bilingual kindergartens) • Age group: 2 to 6 years old • Class size: Up to 32 students • Working shift: 8 hours of work with a 1-hour break (a total commitment of 9 hours). A typical shift is from 8:30 to 17:30. ◆ Job Requirements We are looking for new teachers who: ・Are Native English Speakers* ・Have at least a 2-Year Associate's Degree OR Valid Working Visa ・Are independent and creatively minded, ready to innovate and adapt in any circumstance ・Are team-oriented, passionate, enthusiastic, and creative when teaching children ・Have a strong sense of professionalism and are self-motivated ・Have prior experience working with children (preferred) *Our curriculum emphasizes pronunciation and phonics practice. While we, of course, welcome English speakers from a variety of countries with varying dialects and accents, we ask that you are able to effectively teach and express these concepts in a phonetically natural English environment. Only applicants who are able to meet the highest standards of fluency will be considered. ◆ Cover Letter Please include the following information in your cover letter: ・Available starting date ・Preferred location(s) ・Closest train station to home (if living in Japan) ・Availability for an online interview during the next two weeks (in Japan Standard Time) ** Interviews are typically conducted Monday–Friday, between 10:00 and 18:00 JST. ** Notes: ・We accept only one application per candidate within a six-month period. If you are interested in multiple positions with YARUKI Switch Career/YARUKI Switch Group, or would like to be considered for all open roles, please indicate this in your application. Submitting multiple applications will not increase your chances and may delay processing. ・While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - Billing
jobs.description: You’ll be responsible for leading the Billing team within Kraken Customer. A part of the larger Financials product group that deals with the journey of money through Kraken, the Billing team team builds out the heart of Kraken’s offering, owning systems that deal with calculating how much customers owe, orchestrating the billing flow, and sending customers their bills. As Head of Engineering you’ll be responsible for ensuring we’re working on the highest impact projects and that the engineering team has everything they need to get the job done. Responsibilities Lead an engineering team of roughly 40 engineers across 4 squads located around the globe with almost complete independence. Directly manage 4+ leads and build an impeccably strong leadership layer below you. Optimise ways of working and drive high performance, optimising for efficiency, velocity, and team happiness. Build strong relationships with other leaders within and around Financials to facilitate strong collaboration. Capacity planning, hiring planning, and interviewing so that we’re consistently raising the bar and bringing on the right people. Roll out global strategic objectives within the team, supporting the team through change, building trust, and managing expectations. Work closely with the Head of Engineering community and Senior Management to define global strategic direction and objectives, advocating on behalf of the team and their needs. Drive operational excellence, reducing incidents in production and time to mitigation through quality and ownership. Become an expert in the Billing products and drive the team to build an accurate, reliable, cohesive product. Requirements We are seeking an experienced leader who has successfully led other engineering leaders at scale - this is not a first-time leader-of-leaders opportunity. You won’t be hands-on coding for this role; instead, you will bring deep systems thinking, a strong understanding of software architecture, and the ability to quickly develop a comprehensive understanding of complex technical environments. Proven experience leading large high-performance teams and driving engineering excellence. Proven experience of developing strong leaders and positively impacting teams through them. Strong communication skills in English. The ability to operate largely independently and make decisions that are in the best interests of Kraken. A strong sense of delivery and product - how to balance speed, quality, and competing priorities to hit deadlines while building out a solid cohesive product that will serve us in the future.

jobs.title: English teacher (Greater Tokyo Area)
jobs.description: Job Requirements Required English Level: Native level Required Japanese Level: Not necessary Current Residence Requirement: None Visa Sponsorship: Yes JOB REQUIREMENTS We are looking for caring, professional, and energetic individuals who are passionate about working with children. At Kids UP, we provide a modern and dynamic learning environment that combines the latest technology with interactive games, hands-on activities, and creative lessons to make learning English both fun and effective. The ideal candidate is enthusiastic, adaptable, and enjoys inspiring young learners while working as part of a supportive international team. If you love teaching, have a positive attitude, and want to make a meaningful impact on children's lives, we'd love to hear from you. IDEAL CANDIDATE Kids UP is seeking caring, professional, and energetic educators who are passionate about working with children ages 3–12. The ideal candidate enjoys leading engaging activities, creating a positive learning environment, and inspiring children to develop confidence in English. Job Description Our curriculum combines content and language integrated learning through arts and crafts, exercise-based activities, phonics, imagination-based learning, and traditional English instruction, with a strong emphasis on vocabulary development and grammar. JOB DESCRIPTION At Kids UP, our mission is to create a positive and enjoyable environment for both students and staff. We believe that happy teachers create happy learners, and we are committed to supporting our team members in their professional growth and success. We are currently seeking Native English Teachers who: Enjoy working with children Thrive in a team-oriented environment Are comfortable using technology in a modern classroom setting Bring enthusiasm, creativity, and professionalism to their work Are interested in developing their teaching and leadership skills Kids UP values internal growth and provides opportunities for employees to take on additional responsibilities and leadership roles. Career advancement opportunities may become available based on individual performance, business needs, and position availability. For candidates interested in building a long-term career with Kids UP, there may be opportunities to transition into permanent (Seishain) positions in the future. However, permanent employment is not guaranteed and is subject to company requirements, performance evaluations, and available positions. POSITION DETAILS Kids UP has developed a unique curriculum designed to help children learn English naturally while participating in a variety of fun and educational activities, including arts and crafts, exercise, phonics, imagination-based learning, and more. Teachers work closely with both native English-speaking teachers and bilingual Japanese staff to create a supportive and engaging learning environment that helps students develop language skills and confidence for the future. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday. However, Kids UP hosts special events, seasonal programs, and promotional activities throughout the year, some of which take place on weekends. Employees are required to work on Saturdays and Sundays when assigned to these events. Advance notice will be provided whenever possible. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - Starting salary: ¥267,000–¥300,000 per month (negotiable based on experience and qualifications) - Visa sponsorship and renewal support - Annual salary review based on performance - bonus of ¥100,000 after the third month of the second contract - Additional renewal bonus increases based on performance and continued employment - 10 paid vacation days after six months of employment - Additional paid leave accrued based on length of service - All Japanese national holidays off - Fully paid training program - Transportation reimbursement up to ¥35,000 per month - Enrollment in Japanese social insurance and health insurance programs - Qualification Allowance Kids UP provides an additional monthly allowance of ¥5,000 to employees who possess or obtain one of the following qualifications: - TESOL for Children certification - A university degree in Applied Linguistics or a closely related field - JLPT N1 certification This allowance reflects our commitment to recognizing professional qualifications and specialized expertise in language education. APPLICATION PROCESS 1. Application Screening 2. First Interview (Zoom) 3. Second Interview (Zoom or in person, depending on circumstances) 4. Employment Offer 5. Contract Signing and Visa Support (if applicable) 6. Initial Training Program LOCATION Kids UP operates multiple schools throughout Tokyo, Chiba, Saitama, and Kanagawa. Specific placement details will be discussed during the interview process.

jobs.title: Autonomous Driving / 2D & 3D SLAM Engineer
jobs.description: As a SLAM Engineer at Omakase Robotics, you will own the localization, mapping, and state estimation systems that enable our robots to navigate hospitals, hotels, and retail environments — not just flat warehouse floors. This is a harder problem than what most SLAM engineers work on, and the impact is immediate: our robots are already in real environments and the systems you build will be deployed quickly. Tech Stack Languages: C++, Python Frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PCL, OpenCV, Eigen, Ceres / g2o Tools: Linux, Docker, Git, NVIDIA CUDA (preferred) Who Will Thrive Here Thrive in an early-stage startup where you help define how things work Want direct, hands-on access to real robots — a level of freedom rare at larger companies Move fast, iterate quickly, and care about shipping things that work in the field Excited about Japan’s first robotics OS platform and its real-world deployments (hospital, Tsukuba PoC) Responsibilities Develop, evaluate, and deploy robust 2D/3D SLAM and state-estimation algorithms for real-world service environments Design and implement sensor fusion algorithms (EKF/UKF, graph-based optimization) integrating LiDAR, cameras, IMUs, and GNSS Implement and optimize path planning algorithms (Hybrid A*, TEB, DWA) for dynamic indoor environments Optimize algorithms for real-time performance on edge computing platforms and SoCs Develop online/offline sensor calibration toolchains Integrate SLAM into the full-stack autonomous software framework with perception, control, and simulation teams Apply latest research (NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting) to production mapping challenges Requirements Master’s or PhD (or equivalent professional experience) in Robotics, CS, or Computer Engineering 3+ years of professional or strong academic experience in 2D/3D SLAM, Visual Odometry (VO), or VIO Production-level C++ (C++11/14/17) and solid Python skills Strong mathematical foundation: 3D geometry, linear algebra, coordinate transformations, non-linear optimization (Ceres, g2o) Hands-on experience with ROS/ROS2 in Linux development environments Experience processing real sensor data: 3D LiDAR, depth/RGB cameras, IMUs Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience with autonomous driving frameworks (Autoware, Apollo) — Autoware contributors especially welcome Point cloud processing with PCL or Open3D GPU optimization (CUDA) or Edge AI deployment (NVIDIA Jetson/Orin) Track record of deploying algorithms on physical robots or vehicles (Sim-to-Real) Experience with dynamic path planning (Hybrid A*, TEB, DWA) Docker + Git + CI/CD workflow experience

jobs.title: Robotics Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a Data Engineer at Omakase Robotics, you will build the data infrastructure that feeds our AI and autonomous systems. Every sensor reading, robot action, and field operation generates valuable data — you will make that data reliable, usable, and impactful for VLA model training, SLAM improvement, and operational monitoring. Unlike competitors building warehouse fleet dashboards, your primary charter is the ELA (Embodied Learning from Action) pipeline — training data that makes our robots smarter in the real world. Who Will Thrive Here Thrive in an early-stage startup where you help define how things work Want direct, hands-on access to real robots — a level of freedom rare at larger companies Move fast, iterate quickly, and care about shipping things that work in the field Excited about Japan’s first robotics OS platform and its real-world deployments (hospital, Tsukuba PoC) Responsibilities Build real-time and batch data collection pipelines for robot sensor data and operational logs Design and manage training datasets for VLA models and SLAM systems (preprocessing, versioning, quality control) Design and implement the ELA (Embodied Learning from Action) pipeline end-to-end Architect and operate cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or equivalent) Build robot fleet monitoring dashboards and operational reporting (Grafana, Looker, etc.) Partner with the AI team on experiment tracking and model evaluation infrastructure (MLflow, Kubeflow) Automate data quality monitoring and alerting Build real-time streaming infrastructure (Kafka, Pub/Sub) for live robot telemetry Requirements 3+ years of data engineering experience in a professional setting Strong Python and/or SQL skills for large-scale data processing Experience building and operating cloud data infrastructure (GCP, AWS, or Azure) ETL/ELT pipeline design and implementation (Airflow, dbt, Spark, or equivalent) Data warehouse design experience Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience processing robotics, autonomous systems, or sensor data MLOps experience (MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases) Real-time streaming experience (Kafka, Pub/Sub) Familiarity with multithreading and data-sharing patterns (circular buffers, channels, locks) English-only candidates welcome — Japanese not required for this role

jobs.title: SLAM & Navigation Engineer
jobs.description: Our robots navigate hospitals, hotels, and retail floors — narrow corridors, glass walls, crowds, carts, and lighting that changes by the hour. You will own localization, mapping, and navigation inside Omakase OS: one engineer, full ownership, deployed robots. This role absorbs what was previously posted as two overlapping SLAM positions; we want one strong owner, not a SLAM department. Why this role Full ownership of a stack that ships: your maps and planners run every day at customer sites, and deployment speed you build becomes company margin. You sit next to the manipulation and runtime teams — navigation is integrated, not siloed. Responsibilities Own the localization/mapping stack end to end (we build on LiDAR-inertial odometry, e.g. FAST-LIO-class systems) for indoor human-shared environments Build robust state estimation: sensor fusion across LiDAR, cameras, IMU, and wheel odometry; degeneracy handling; relocalization Develop and tune path planning and obstacle avoidance for dynamic indoor spaces (people are not static obstacles) Build the mapping/calibration toolchain used at every customer-site deployment (fast site bring-up is a product feature) Optimize for edge compute (Jetson-class): CPU/GPU budgets shared with policy inference Validate in simulation and on robots; define navigation acceptance tests FDEs can run at deployment time Requirements 3+ years hands-on SLAM / VIO / LiDAR-inertial odometry experience with real sensor data on real platforms (research or production; simulation-only does not qualify) Production-grade modern C++ and solid Python Strong foundations in 3D geometry, state estimation (EKF/UKF, factor graphs), and nonlinear optimization ROS / ROS 2 on Linux; you have debugged bad odometry at a real site before Point cloud processing (PCL / Open3D) and multi-sensor calibration experience Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. FAST-LIO / LIO-SAM family internals; loop closure and map management at building scale Deployment on embedded GPUs (Jetson), CUDA optimization Navigation among dense pedestrians; social navigation literature awareness Docker, CI/CD; Japanese language is a plus for site visits

jobs.title: Contracting Manager – Travel Purchasing / Business Development
jobs.description: In this position, you will lead contract negotiations and relationship building with key suppliers that make up our travel products, including accommodations, activities, and restaurants. To ensure a high-quality travel experience, you will strengthen trust with existing partners, develop new partners, negotiate prices, and manage contracts. You will also lead a team and be involved in team development and business improvement. Specific responsibilities include: - Negotiating and concluding contracts with domestic travel suppliers, including accommodations, activities, and restaurants. - Developing and building relationships with new suppliers. - Managing and updating contract terms (fees, cancellation policies, etc.) - Maintaining and regularly reviewing relationships with existing suppliers. - Sharing contract-related information internally and accurately registering and managing it in the system. - Proposing improvements to business processes. - Supporting and developing team members. Your work will be diverse, including interacting with suppliers in a variety of areas and genres, but the ultimate goal is hearing "thank you" from our customers. This is a rewarding position that is crucial to creating travel experiences. We look forward to hearing from you if you are passionate about building a better company together with us! Based on employee feedback, we have been officially certified as a "Great Place to Work" by Great Place to Work®. [Appealing Points] - Experience the joy and sense of accomplishment you share with our customers when we complete tours safely and comfortably. - As the Japanese subsidiary of the overseas-based Intrepid Group, you can work with a global perspective while in Japan. - Complimentary access to Intrepid tours. - Training and qualification support programs are available, allowing you to improve your skills using study leave. - Number of Interviews: 2 (possibly 3 if necessary) - Reference Checks: Yes (minimum 2 people)

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Core Banking & Product Features)
jobs.description: Background of Recruitment We are looking for Backend Engineers to drive the continued growth of the PayPay Group by continuously improving our banking systems and building a robust, flexible next-generation technology platform. For New Bank Project, we are redefining finance and building a new banking platform through two key initiatives. Redefining the Financial Experience The PayPay Group is building a digital financial platform where users can seamlessly access to every aspect of their financial lives—from earning, growing, protecting, and saving money—all within a single app. As the banking foundation of the PayPay ecosystem, PayPay Bank plays a critical role in enabling every financial service across the platform. By continuously evolving our banking capabilities, we are creating entirely new financial experiences that go beyond the boundaries of traditional banking. Our ambition is not simply to operate a bank—we are challenging ourselves to redefine what finance can be. Building an In-House Core Banking System Today’s banking systems demand greater agility, faster development cycles, higher quality, and better cost efficiency. To meet these challenges, PayPay Bank is building a next-generation core banking system entirely in-house, embracing the same global engineering culture that powers PayPay. This is an unique opportunity to contribute to one of the largest core banking modernization projects in the financial industry. You’ll help design and build the technology platform that supports one of Japan’s largest digital user bases while shaping the future of banking from the ground up. To drive transformation at PayPay’s exceptional speed, we are looking for engineers who are adaptable, proactive, and eager to take ownership beyond defined roles and responsibilities. We value people who create opportunities for themselves, embrace challenges, and turn ideas into impact. Rather than being attached to a particular programming language or technology, we view technology as a means to solve meaningful problems. You will collaborate with your team to maximize product impact and business value, always putting the user first. If you’re passionate about building products with a user-first mindset and helping redefine the future of finance, this is an opportunity for you. ※ After joining the company, you are expected to be seconded to PayPay Bank as a member of the above project. Tech Stack We select the best combination of tech at times. Excellent skills in other common programming languages Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and the basics of object-oriented programming Schema design in DB (RDB, NoSQL, etc.) and efficient query creation Experience in web application development and tuning, and development with security considerations English (Business level conversational proficiency) Hands-on experience with AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, CodeWhisperer, or similar) in professional software development. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Development experience in the financial industry Experience implementing platform components such as RESTful API, Pub/Sub systems, database clients Development experience using AWS services Experience in system design, developing applications/web products handling large transactions, and applications/web products requiring scalability Experience with microservices Ability to conduct business in Japanese (native-level proficiency or equivalent to JLPT N1/N2) Proven track record of integrating AI-assisted development into system design and delivery Contributions to AI-related open-source projects or automation of workflows with AI is a plus

jobs.title: Corporate IT & Security Specialist
jobs.description: You will be joining the Internal IT team, which enables the effective use of technology for HENNGE’s approximately 350 full-time employees. While our team’s core mission is to support the infrastructure for maximum organizational performance, your role is specialized to focus on governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). We currently have an Information Security Lead who maintains our security posture and leads our ISO 27001 (ISMS) certification (including related standards like 27017 and 27018). jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Japanese: Conversational Bachelor's degree or higher 12 years of education where English was the main medium of instruction Visa sponsorship available Description Borderlink is hiring Assistant Language Teachers (ALTs)! As an ALT, you won't just be teaching grammar and vocabulary, you'll be co-leading vibrant, activity-filled classes alongside local Japanese teachers. But the true magic of being an ALT happens beyond the classroom. It’s found in the shared moments and memories you will make at your schools- the conversations at lunch, the experiences in school clubs, and the authentic cultural exchanges that transform a standard teaching job into the adventure of a lifetime. Whether you’re applying from abroad or you’re already living in Japan and searching for a fresh start, the opportunity to teach next generation starts right here. Read on to discover the exciting paths that lie ahead. 🌎 Applying from Overseas 🌎 Overseas applicants interested in joining Borderlink are encouraged to apply now for April 2027 positions. Successful candidates will receive guidance throughout the process, including visa applications and pre-arrival preparations. 🗾 Applying from Japan 🗾 Applicants currently living in Japan with a valid residence or work visa are welcome to apply for current and upcoming openings. Priority may be given to those with ALT experience, a Japanese driver’s license, or flexibility to relocate. Part-time positions are also available in select locations. 🌸 Why Choose the ALT Life 🌸 ⭐️ Enjoy balance as your schedule runs Monday through Friday between 7:45 am and 6:00 pm, leaving your evenings, weekends, national holidays, and school vacations free. ⭐️ Immerse yourself in real classroom teaching within the public school system. This is a unique opportunity not available in every English teaching position. ⭐️ Work alongside Japanese teachers and learn how to adapt to different teaching styles and learning levels. ⭐️ Grow personally and professionally throughout the school year as you experience Japanese school life and work culture. ⭐️ Become a positive figure in the lives of your students, with the possibility of working in elementary and junior high schools, and even at the kindergarten and senior high school level. ⚠️ Requirements ⚠️ ⭕ University graduate holding a bachelor's degree or higher. ⭕ Completed at least 12 years of education where English was the primary language of instruction for all of your classes. ※ Both of these are required for visa sponsorship and are non-negotiable. However, you do not need to be from a native English-speaking country to apply. As long as you have completed 12 years of English-medium education (e.g., international school, bilingual education, or study abroad), you are eligible to join us as an ALT. [Desirable Qualities] - Prior teaching experience with young learners (especially experience in Japan) - ESL-related certificate (TEFL, TESOL, CELTA, etc) - Valid driver's license and willing to drive in Japan - Conversational-level Japanese speaking/listening skills 🎯 What Sets Borderlink Apart 🎯 ➡️ Variety: We are based nationwide, and your teaching destination can have the fast-paced lifestyle of a dense urban city or the peaceful charm and affordable living of the Japanese countryside. Borderlink has ALTs placed all over mainland Japan. ➡️ Personable: You will always have a dedicated, familiar support team available to ensure you know exactly who to turn to for daily advice or in the event of an emergency. ➡️ Education-focused: A significant number of our corporate staff members come from strong educational backgrounds including many who began their own journey right where you are now. ➡️ Career Growth: Once you've gained valuable experience in the classroom, we offer real pathways for professional growth, including the exciting possibility of stepping up and joining our HR team. ✨ Benefits ✨ Borderlink ALTs enjoy a range of benefits and support, including: ✅ Visa sponsorship and renewal support (where applicable) ✅ Enrollment in Japan's social insurance system (where applicable) ✅ Assistance with finding housing ✅ Paid holidays (as stipulated by the contract) ✅ Year-round paid training sessions (including orientation/initial training) ✅ Free Japanese lessons for beginners ✅ Help with securing a rental car (for driving positions) at a much more reasonable price than other rental services ✅ Personalized, friendly assistance with handling administrative tasks and advice to help you hone your teaching skills ✅ Access to teaching materials and our vast library of educational resources ✅ Priority for future positions and/or possibility of career advancement in the company ✅ A yearly calendar of working days to help you manage your schedule 📝 How to Apply 📝 Please apply directly to this job post with your cover letter attached, or visit our website. We carefully screen every application ourselves and hold online interviews throughout the week. Thank you for your interest in working with Borderlink. We're waiting to hear from you soon. *Please note that as we receive a high number of applicants, only those who meet all necessary requirements and pass the initial screening will be contacted for an interview. *If you previously worked with Borderlink, your application process can be expedited after evaluation. *For citizens of the Philippines residing overseas, please apply through our affiliated agency. Contact information is available on our website under "How to Apply" "Applying from Overseas".

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Developer Experience (DevEx)
jobs.description: As Money Forward continues to scale our product portfolio and engineering organization, strengthening developer productivity has become a strategic priority for the CTO Office and the broader MF Engineering group. We are evolving our developer experience, platforms, and governance to support increasingly complex products and a growing number of engineers in Japan and Vietnam. To accelerate this transformation, we are looking for a Principal Engineer who can take ownership of developer productivity as a company-wide capability. You will be a key partner to the CTO, engineering leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders in defining and executing this strategy. Technology Stack Web Server-side: Languages / Frameworks:Java, Kotlin, Ruby, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc. Frameworks / Libraries:Spring Boot, Rails, Next.js, React, etc. Database: RDBMS / NoSQL:MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, etc. Middleware: Containers / Web / Others:Docker, Nginx, Kafka, etc. Platform: Cloud / Infra:AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, on-premise environments, etc. Data / Analytics: Data Pipeline / Analytics:Apache DevLake, BigQuery, Looker Studio, etc. Developer Experience / Internal Platform: Developer Portal / Platform:Backstage-based internal developer portal (DFP), internal AI platform, internal CI/CD platform, etc. Tools Used Repository Management: GitHub, GitLab (depending on team) CI/CD: GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Argo CD, etc. Development Environment: Docker, Terraform, Terraform Enterprise, local development environments, VS Code and other IDEs, etc. Monitoring / Logging: DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, etc. Project Management: Jira, Notion, Confluence, etc. Communication: Slack, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Meet), etc. Security: Dependabot, Snyk, security scanning tools integrated into CI/CD, etc. Responsibilities You will lead developer productivity and developer experience initiatives across Money Forward Cloud and the wider group, working closely with engineering teams in Japan and Vietnam, the CISO and PRE/SRE organizations, as well as Product and management. While architecture and governance leaders own company-wide technical design, you will own how productively developers across the company work and how smoothly they can deliver high-quality software. Bridge the CTO, engineering leadership, and Product to surface real productivity problems, propose data-informed solutions, and align on which value areas to prioritize and invest in first. Make full use of DFP (our Backstage-based developer portal) and evolve it where it provides leverage—so product teams can self-serve common needs such as templates, shared libraries, CI/CD pipelines, standard patterns, and golden paths—treating it as one productivity lever rather than a goal in itself. Define and instrument engineering productivity: select appropriate metrics (such as DORA, SPACE, or team-specific indicators), measure honestly using our productivity-data stack (Apache DevLake, BigQuery, Looker Studio), and use these insights to identify friction points and demonstrate impact. Lead developer-experience and tooling programs end-to-end, including developer tooling, CI/CD and build-time improvements, internal documentation and templates, and especially the rollout of AI tools, agents, and workflows on our internal AI Platform—covering technical design, implementation, and adoption. Identify practices that work well in specific teams and scale them across the organization by codifying patterns, sharing knowledge, and driving adoption through communication, enablement, and change management. Partner with the CISO and PRE/SRE organizations on security and reliability initiatives that touch developer experience, ensuring secure and reliable defaults without owning those mandates directly. Partner with the FinOps owner to embed cost awareness into developer tooling and golden paths, helping teams make cost-effective architectural and operational choices while not owning the overall cost program yourself. Support the architecture and governance review process where it intersects with developer experience, ensuring that standards and guidelines are practical, discoverable, and easy for teams to adopt. Communicate clearly and credibly with both engineers and executives in English and Japanese, including proposals, status updates, decision records, post-implementation reviews, and success stories. Requirements Hands-on software engineering experience (including at least one of the following): Experience building and operating developer tools, internal platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and build systems. Experience in SRE, infrastructure, or production engineering. Experience as a Tech Lead in a product or platform team. Experience driving technical changes across multiple teams through influence, without a direct reporting line. Experience collaborating with distributed or remote teams across multiple locations. Proven track record of leading technical design, utilizing experimental approaches, and delivering incremental improvements in a complex, multi-team environment. Strong communication skills in both English and Japanese, with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders from executive management to frontline engineers. Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience leading multi-team or company-wide initiatives related to Developer Productivity (DevProd/DevEx) or Platform Engineering. Experience designing and operating internal developer portals (e.g., Backstage) and internal platforms (including providing golden paths, templates, and shared services). Practical experience with productivity frameworks (e.g., DORA or SPACE) and designing/tracking meaningful metrics. Experience collecting, transforming, and visualizing engineering data using data pipelines and analytics infrastructure (e.g., Apache DevLake, BigQuery, Looker Studio). Experience collaborating with security, reliability, and operations teams to embed best practices into the development process. Management or Tech Lead experience in a large-scale, multilingual organization spanning Japan and overseas (e.g., Vietnam). Experience using AI-assisted development tools or driving the organizational adoption of AI workflows. Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization. Experience driving company-wide rollouts and organizational change. Contributions to the tech community (e.g., OSS, tech blogs, speaking at conferences). Experience in AI development and/or experience in using AI tools to improve development processes. - Money Forward is at a major turning point, shifting “from Cloud to AI.” We are currently driving “AX (AI Transformation)”—the next step beyond DX—with the goal of providing “Digital Workers,” where AI agents autonomously execute tasks. As we enter a phase of evolving into Japan’s No. 1 back-office AI company by integrating AI agents into all of our products in the future, we are looking for individuals who can contribute to AI-driven development and value creation.

jobs.title: SaaS Management Department Manager, Global IT Division,Tokyo
jobs.description: While productivity is a crucial factor for Money Forward as it grows into a Big Tech company, there are currently several challenges with SaaS selection and operation, and we are not always able to provide the optimal IT working environment. It is an urgent task for the Information Systems Division to plan and operate a SaaS portfolio befitting a global company of 5,000 people, and to contribute to the further acceleration of development and business by thoroughly promoting their utilization. We are looking for an individual who can join us in this exciting phase of transformation from a Japanese startup to a global enterprise, and drive projects related to SaaS introduction and operation as a SaaS Management Department Manager, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders! About the Department The Corporate SaaS Management Department within the Global IT Division, where you will be assigned, manages and promotes the utilization of SaaS used by all group employees, including those in overseas offices (Vietnam, India). The team’s mission is “To provide a state where all employees can focus on essential value creation through SaaS,” and they are responsible for the following tasks: Operational management and improvement of SaaS used across the group (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, etc.) Planning, selection, introduction, adoption, and operation of newly introduced SaaS Support for the utilization of company-wide standard SaaS Standardization and optimization of IT costs Formulation of SaaS portfolio and AI utilization plans with a view towards long-term management strategies Tools Used Office Suite: Google Workspace Collaboration: Slack, Zoom, Jira, Miro, Figma, etc. IdP: Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory) Public Cloud: AWS, GCP Responsibilities You will be managing a team that is involved in everything from planning and promotion related to SaaS management to actual operation, based on your interests and experience. This role will require you to provide technical guidance for the team as well as managing projects that are aligned with the goals of the organizations (aka Player/ Manager). You will be in charge of large-scale projects affecting the entire group, working in coordination with overseas offices such as Vietnam and India in addition to domestic locations. Research on SaaS functions and promotion of their utilization (including AI utilization) Definition of company-wide information sharing methods, SaaS selection, and introduction Establishment of group-wide management policies and operational setup (license granting, inventory, change management, etc.) Budget planning and expenditure management, building relationships with vendors Business process improvement for manual operations Internal help desk tasks: Handling inquiries Building and managing knowledge for users Requirements Five or more years of experience of project management. Expertise in user and group provisioning standards, including hands-on experience with SAML, SCIM etc. Experience in leading an implementation of SaaS/ERP products in medium to large organizations. A working knowledge of Generative AI, and AI from an end user perspective, and have experience using it in a corporate environment Experience in leading the planning, requirements definition, introduction, and operation of internal systems Experience operating corporate IT SaaS (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, etc.) Able to work in a networked organization Business basic level Japanese (JLPT N2, CEFR B2 equivalent or higher) Business basic level English (TOEIC 700 equivalent or higher) Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. A track record of managing IT licenses and negotiating license agreements. Experience in managing or designing an Identity Access Management system. Experience in improving operations using SaaS Web APIs, etc. Work experience at a System Integrator (SIer), enterprise cloud solutions provider, or IT consulting firm A project management certification: PMP and/or Agile Project Management certification Experience in AI development and/or experience in using AI tools to improve development processes. Money Forward is at a major turning point, shifting “from Cloud to AI.” We are currently driving “AX (AI Transformation)” the next step beyond DX with the goal of providing “Digital Workers,” where AI agents autonomously execute tasks. As we enter a phase of evolving into Japan’s No. 1 back-office AI company by integrating AI agents into all of our products in the future, we are looking for individuals who can contribute to AI-driven development and value creation.

jobs.title: AEON Online Lesson – English Conversation Instructor (Remote Work available)
jobs.description: Requirements English: Native level Must currently reside in Japan Description Use your English skills to support learners with AEON Online Lesson! We are seeking passionate, professional instructors committed to helping Japanese English learners achieve their goals! As an AEON Online outsource instructor, you will teach one-on-one English conversation classes online. After signing the outsource contract, we provide onboarding workshops and demo lessons to help you understand our materials and lesson flows prior to starting a teaching schedule. Our instructors teach using a wide variety of quality materials produced both in-house and 3rd party. Highlights * Enjoy flexible working arrangements. Because lessons are online, you can work from home in a way that fits your lifestyle. Many instructors balance this role alongside full-time jobs, studies, household responsibilities, or childcare. *Make a meaningful difference. You’ll have a positive impact on both your students’ lives and Japanese society. Beyond improving English skills, you’ll help learners gain confidence and open up new opportunities. Hearing students say “I can do it now” or “Thank you” is one of the most rewarding parts of this work. *Develop your communication and teaching skills. Through lessons and training workshops, you can continually strengthen your presentation, communication, and teaching abilities. * Connect with people from diverse backgrounds. Work with learners of different ages, professions, and life experiences, expanding your perspectives and values. If you have an interest in Japan or Japanese culture, building relationships with Japanese learners can be especially rewarding. The ideal candidate enjoys leading engaging activities, creating a positive learning environment, and inspiring children to develop confidence in English. Our curriculum combines content and language integrated learning through arts and crafts, exercise-based activities, phonics, imagination-based learning, and traditional English instruction, with a strong emphasis on vocabulary development and grammar. JOB DESCRIPTION At Kids UP, our mission is to create a positive and enjoyable environment for both students and staff. We believe that happy teachers create happy learners, and we are committed to supporting our team members in their professional growth and success. We are currently seeking Native English Teachers who: Enjoy working with children Thrive in a team-oriented environment Are comfortable using technology in a modern classroom setting Bring enthusiasm, creativity, and professionalism to their work Are interested in developing their teaching and leadership skills Kids UP values internal growth and provides opportunities for employees to take on additional responsibilities and leadership roles. Career advancement opportunities may become available based on individual performance, business needs, and position availability. For candidates interested in building a long-term career with Kids UP, there may be opportunities to transition into permanent (Seishain) positions in the future. However, permanent employment is not guaranteed and is subject to company requirements, performance evaluations, and available positions. POSITION DETAILS Kids UP has developed a unique curriculum designed to help children learn English naturally while participating in a variety of fun and educational activities, including arts and crafts, exercise, phonics, imagination-based learning, and more. Teachers work closely with both native English-speaking teachers and bilingual Japanese staff to create a supportive and engaging learning environment that helps students develop language skills and confidence for the future. The standard work schedule is Monday through Friday. However, Kids UP hosts special events, seasonal programs, and promotional activities throughout the year, some of which take place on weekends. Employees are required to work on Saturdays and Sundays when assigned to these events. Advance notice will be provided whenever possible. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - Starting salary: ¥267,000–¥300,000 per month (negotiable based on experience and qualifications) - Visa sponsorship and renewal support - Annual salary review based on performance - bonus of ¥100,000 after the third month of the second contract - Additional renewal bonus increases based on performance and continued employment - 10 paid vacation days after six months of employment - Additional paid leave accrued based on length of service - All Japanese national holidays off - Fully paid training program - Transportation reimbursement up to ¥35,000 per month - Enrollment in Japanese social insurance and health insurance programs - Qualification Allowance Kids UP provides an additional monthly allowance of ¥5,000 to employees who possess or obtain one of the following qualifications: - TESOL for Children certification - A university degree in Applied Linguistics or a closely related field - JLPT N1 certification This allowance reflects our commitment to recognizing professional qualifications and specialized expertise in language education. APPLICATION PROCESS 1. Application Screening 2. First Interview (Zoom) 3. Second Interview (Zoom or in person, depending on circumstances) 4. Employment Offer 5. Contract Signing and Visa Support (if applicable) 6. Initial Training Program LOCATION Kids UP operates multiple schools throughout Tokyo, Chiba, Saitama, and Kanagawa. Specific placement details will be discussed during the interview process.

Only successful candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.title: AI Agents Ops Engineer - Quality Improvement (HR Product Development Division), Tokyo
jobs.description: Money Forward is entering a new era of growth. As we scale our HR domain, which includes mission-critical products like Money Forward Cloud Payroll, Human Resources Management, and Money Forward Cloud My Number, the complexity of aligning product requirements with ever-changing Japanese labor laws and regulations has increased exponentially. Since then, we have expanded our product lineup and now offer eight products in the HR domain. The HR domain holds immense potential for market share expansion and is identified as a key area to accelerate business growth. As our user base expands globally, improving product quality through systemic execution is an urgent priority. We are seeking a hands-on AI Agents Ops Engineer - Quality Improvement to drive product excellence through technical execution, deep domain analysis, and advanced AI implementation. This role is focused on improving quality across the SDLC by auditing development processes and integrating AI agents to automate complex quality workflows and ensure high-integrity releases. The Mission: AI-Driven Workflow Automation: Leverage cutting-edge AI technologies (LLMs, AgentOps) to automate, test, and enhance our quality frameworks, removing manual dependencies across the engineering lifecycle. Full-Lifecycle AI Integration & Auditing: Integrate AI agents into the overall development cycle (including the upstream Discovery Phase) to proactively identify systemic quality gaps, analyze requirements against regulatory standards, and audit architectural risks before coding begins. Global Quality Championing: Act as a key technical driver across our cross-functional, global development hubs (Japan, Vietnam, India). Partner directly with engineers and product managers to embed quality-first telemetry, advanced observability, and high-risk validation frameworks into the standard development loop. Current Issues & Strategic Pivot The Strategic Goal Money Forward’s FY28 goal is to achieve sales of over 100 billion yen. To reach this milestone, our HR Product Development Department must maintain an aggressive release cadence while navigating the extreme complexity of Japanese labor laws and global organizational expansion. The Complexity Wall Currently, traditional QA efforts rely heavily on manual verification. With 8+ integrated products and a distributed engineering team, we have hit a technical scalability wall: Regulatory Bottlenecks: Manually cross-checking product requirements against evolving HR regulations causes delivery lead-time inflation. Discovery Phase Gaps: Without automated, AI-assisted validation in upstream discovery, hidden structural and logical risks surface too late, resulting in costly re-engineering. Headcount Scaling Limits: Linearly adding more testing headcount is unsustainable. True velocity requires automated self-scaling quality infrastructure. The Solution: We are shifting from standard domain-dependent manual validation to an AI-Augmented Quality Strategy. We need a technical specialist who can build and deploy multi-agent AI workflows that serve as our automated “regulatory brain,” “discovery-phase auditor,” and “production reliability guardrail.” Technology Stack Backend: Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, gRPC, Sidekiq Pro, RSpec, Kotlin Frontend: TypeScript, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Bootstrap-vue, Vue apollo, Jest Infrastructure / IaC: Amazon EKS, Aurora, ElastiCache, S3, Terraform Test Automation Stack: Playwright with TypeScript Responsibilities In this role, you will be the key driver in elevating product quality by performing deep domain analyses, identifying patterns in historical release issues, and architecting actionable plans to prevent recurrence. Leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to automate, test, and enhance our quality frameworks, ensuring high-integrity releases. Audit the end-to-end SDLC, proactively identifying systemic quality gaps and architectural risks. Architect and implement AI-driven automation strategies and AI-augmented debugging workflows. Monitor production quality through advanced observability, logs, and metrics to continuously refine our quality loop. Partner cross-functionally with engineering and product teams to integrate quality-first thinking into the development lifecycle. Requirements Expertise in AI implementation (LLMs, Agent Ops) for engineering productivity. Proven track record in technical auditing and domain-specific quality analysis. Deep proficiency in CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), and test automation. Ability to translate complex technical data into strategic, actionable roadmaps. Strong influence skills to champion quality standards across engineering teams. English : Business-level (TOEIC 700+ equivalent). Japanese : Business-level Nice to haves While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following. Experience in people management or formal team leadership. Background in mentoring engineers and fostering technical growth within a team. Experience with HR or back-office systems. Experience in AI development and/or experience in using AI tools to improve development processes. Money Forward is at a major turning point, shifting “from Cloud to AI.” We are currently driving “AX (AI Transformation)”—the next step beyond DX—with the goal of providing “Digital Workers,” where AI agents autonomously execute tasks. As we enter a phase of evolving into Japan’s No. 1 back-office AI company by integrating AI agents into all of our products in the future, we are looking for individuals who can contribute to AI-driven development and value creation.

jobs.title: Full-Time Instructor
jobs.description: Requirements English: Fluent Japanese: Basic Must currently reside in Japan TESOL/TEFL/CELTA Comfortable leading hands-on STEAM activities Visa sponsorship available Description Full-Time Instructor EON Kids Academy Job Overview EON Kids Academy is a bilingual English after-school program in Tokyo, launched on April 6, 2026. We go beyond traditional academics by nurturing children’s creativity, communication, collaboration, leadership, and confidence in both English and Japanese. Our curriculum blends English learning, inquiry-based learning, STEAM, social-emotional learning, and essential life skills to prepare children for a globally connected future. Our mission is to equip children with the tools to thrive in a globally connected world. Our vision is to inspire young minds to become global leaders through immersive English learning, inquiry-based learning, and essential life skills. We are looking for a Full-Time Instructor who is passionate about working with elementary-aged children and creating a fun, safe, structured, and engaging learning environment. This role goes beyond teaching English. The instructor will support the full daily experience of our after-school program, including English lessons, homework support, classroom routines, student safety, learning activities, and team collaboration. As part of a growing startup team, the instructor will also play an important role in helping build the culture and quality of EON Kids Academy from the beginning. Position Details Employment Type: Full-time Location: Setagaya-ku, Tokyo, Japan Residence Requirement: Applicants must currently reside in Japan. Start Date: To be discussed during the interview process. Work Schedule: Schedule will be based on company needs and after-school program operations. Typical program hours may include afternoon-to-evening shifts, school vacation programs, and other scheduled activities. 11:00 AM - 19:00 PM Monday - Friday Key Responsibilities 1. Teaching and Learning The Full-Time Instructor will: - Plan lessons according to curriculum requirements - Deliver daily English-based lessons, including phonics, reading, listening, speaking, and writing - Lead interactive activities such as games, group projects, and STEAM inquiry-based lessons - Conduct themed intensive learning programs during school vacation periods, such as Spring, Summer, and Winter programs - Guide learners through lessons focused on social-emotional learning and life skills - Support students with different English levels across Grades 1–6 - Use clear, child-friendly English during lessons and daily routines 2. STEAM Lab Support The Full-Time Instructor will: - Lead hands-on STEAM activities using provided lesson plans and materials - Support simple science activities, creative building tasks, project-based learning, and problem-solving activities - Encourage curiosity, teamwork, creativity, and guided reflection - Manage materials, student safety, and classroom behavior during active learning activities 3. Learner Support The Full-Time Instructor will: - Provide homework support focused on building independent study routines and time-management skills - Guide learners in communication, study habits, and social skills - Encourage confidence, effort, and active participation -Support students with patience, respect, and positive encouragement 4. Classroom Management The Full-Time Instructor will: - Maintain a safe, structured, and positive learning environment - Manage daily routines, including arrival, transitions, activities, lesson materials, and dismissal - Handle student behavior calmly and respectfully - Support smooth movement between lessons, activities, and program areas - Create a classroom atmosphere where children feel safe, included, and motivated to learn 5. Curriculum Support The Full-Time Instructor will: - Follow lesson plans created by the Curriculum Creator or Head Instructor - Prepare instructional materials such as worksheets, games, visuals, and activity materials - Provide feedback to improve lessons and learner experience - Adapt lesson delivery when needed to support student understanding and participation 6. Safety and Supervision The Full-Time Instructor will: - Ensure learner safety at all times - Conduct attendance checks and regular supervision - Support emergency drills and safety procedures - Assist with student movement inside and outside the classroom - Support bus-related supervision if needed - Follow all company safety and child protection procedures 7. Team Collaboration The Full-Time Instructor will: - Work closely with the Curriculum Creator, Head Instructor, and operations team - Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and feedback discussions - Share learner updates and observations with the appropriate team members - Communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally with colleagues - Support a positive and cooperative team culture 8. Learner Progress Reports The Full-Time Instructor will: - Document learner activities, progress, participation, and performance - Support quarterly learner progress reports - Record assessment results and learner observations - Provide clear and useful feedback about student growth, effort, and classroom behavior 9. Observation and Evaluation Instructor performance may be periodically observed to maintain high standards and support professional development.
